paras: Bismilla hir-Rahman nir-Rahim

O Husamuddin, you are the light of the heart. Now there is an enthusiasm to write the sixth volume of the Math(s)navi. This is due to the impacts of a great scholar like you, so that this is actually to be called as Husami’s message to spread over the world. this, I am presenting before you for your acceptance as the sixth volume, so as to complete the Math(s)navi in full. O well aware of the inner meanings, I present before you this sixth volume to complete the entire work, so that with these six volumes, all the six dimensions may be brightened, so that one who has not gone into the six dimensions, may traverse them. Though the fact is: love has nothing to do with numbers like five and six, its object is only to be attracted by the beloved and nothing else. Yet there is a possibility that love may permit me to speak of worth-revealing secrets, so that those capable of knowing the secrets, may see the inner aspects which have been explained earlier only in the form of hints.

sections.heading: Rejectors Need Not Cause Annoyance
paras: Secrets have to be revealed only to those who are interested and capable of bearing with them, not at all to the rejectors. Ears of the rejectors cannot understand the secrets and keep them as secrets. But God has directed us to invite the people toward the truth and this invitation has nothing to do with its acceptance and rejection. H. Nuuh went on inviting all the people towards the message for nine hundred years, but the rejection by his people went on increasing at every step. But he never turned his reins away from invitation nor he entered into the cave of silence. This is because, no caravan ever deviates or halts from the path upon the barking of dogs. So also, the pace of the bright moon does not go slow upon the barking’s of dogs. The moon spreads its light without caring for the crying’s and barking’s of dogs. Not only this, every one works as per his instinct and capabilities. God provides a job to everyone to carry on as per his abilities in order to test him. When the dog cannot give its barking’s habit as it is a kind of sickness for it; and such being the case, how the moon slackens its speed upon the dogs barking? So also, vinegar cannot get rid of its sourness. However, in order to reduce its sourness, more sugar requires to be added to sweeten it. Its sourness is like a calamity, yet the sweetness of honey being compounded with it makes the medicine: sikanjbeen. If these are not mixed proportionately there will be imbalance in it, and this can be done by increasing sweetness.

sections.heading: Water of Generosity Reduces Sourness
paras: This is what happened in the case of H. Nuuh. When his community went on increasing the sourness, of its vinegar, river also went on adding its water as sugar upon H. Nuuh. The sugar for him was the help that was given to him by the Ocean of generosity, which increases, as the vinegar of the people increases. One who has a thousand times of the capabilities of men is a saint rather he is a great bondman of God like a prophet, as large as a hundred epochs. A pot which creates the passage of the flow of water of this river, is so honourable that a hundred rivers like Jaihun will submit in humility before it. In particular this river, rather all rivers, upon hearing the example of this river and its greatness feel so ashamed and lowly that their mouths feel bitterness in them and these small rivers got merged with the large river and get its name. the comparison of this large world of senses with that insensible, spiritual, hidden, larger world is such that this world feels ashamed and runs and jumps away upon facing it. The examples and comparisons that I give are too narrow and totally devoid of any match whatsoever. What comparison can be made of scrap with God who is so special as to have no comparison at all.

sections.heading: Good and Bad Go Together
paras: The comparison between the ordinary men and great men of God is like the crowing of a crow in the vineyard. This crowing does not reduce the melodious tunes of the nightingale. Yet God is the purchaser of everybody in the auction house of the world, because world is an auction house made by God as He does what He wills: Yaf ‘alullaahu maa yasha’u: (Ibrahim: 14: 27). Thorns of the forests are the food of fire, so also of the rejectors. And fragrance of the flowers is the inspirer of pleasure for those who have taste for it. They instantly accept the invitation of the prophets and saints. Filth is hated by us, but it the food of the dogs and pigs. If the filthy fellows go on committing filthy acts, water is always engaged in cleaning the filth. If the world becomes of full of thorns and garbage, fire wipes them out in a moment. If snakes are spilling their poison and the bitter fellows are causing tension to us, there are honeybees that are building godowns and jilling them with honey and sugar atop the hill’s forts and trees. Although Poisons spread themselves in the world and make it poisonous, the antidotes instantly come forward and destroy the poisonous effects.

sections.heading: Contradictions and Oppositions
paras: If you think over, you will see that the world is made up of contradictions and oppositions. Every particle is at war with another particle. This is so with faith and faithlessness also. One particle fly toward the left and the other comes forward on the right side. One particle moves in the upper side and the other in the lower side. They are on the opposite side of each other. You can see an actual war between them, because of their inner inclinations. This practical war between them is because of their hidden conflict. All conflicts are for this very same reason. Compare this contradiction with the contradiction of the good and bad people. These are the exponents of the different attributes of God. This account of the particle goes out of this world’s account which gets lost in the sun. when the particles of the body and of the breaths get annihilated war between getting annihilated in the sun. the particle loses their physical movement and take rest, because: to God we belong and to Him is our return Innaa lillaahi wa inna ilaihi raji ‘uuna (Baqarah: 2: 156). We all return to the ocean of our original light, and we become to drink our own milk from our own source of milk.

sections.heading: Physical, Mental, Ideological Conflicts
paras: O the one losing having lost the path on the path of life like the devil showing himself like flowers and gardens, you are away from the fundamental principles of life. Do not blabber and indulge in self praises. On war and on peace are due to the light of our own physical eyes and seeing with our own inner consciousness. It is not due to our own efforts. All our actions plying like a ball between the two fingers of God. Both these are brought about by God. Physical battles as between bodies, active wars as between armies and verbal wars, as of the ideological conflicts are in terrible conflict with each other, part by part, and all in all. This world survives and remains well settled because of these conflicts. You may think over about all elements, and find out the truth of this matter. The four elements — earth, water, air and fire are the pillars upon which is settled the roof of the world. the pillar of water destroys the pillar of fire. Thus, the foundation of the world is contradiction, and therefore, we are all at war with each other to gain profit avoid loss to ourselves and cause loss and destruction to the peace of others. Not only that your affairs are in opposition to those of others, even their impact are also at loggerheads with those of others.
Conflicts within Man himself

Even your own affairs are in conflict with you like dacoits looting them. When such is the case within yourself, how can you be in consonance with others. Look at the conflict of the armies of your own affairs within yourself as to how they are inimical and opposed to each other’s affairs. If you look at these conflicts within yourself, there will be no need for you to be at war with others. If you do so, there is a possibility of God giving relief to you from your own conflicts within yourself and take you in a world of peace where there are no conflicts, and everything is the same. That other world is nothing but everlasting and well settled, as it is not made of the comparison of opposites. The mutual destruction in this world is due to the conflict between opposites and when there are no opposites, there is nothing but construction and lastingness. Uncomparable God has negated the existence of opposites there, and there is no sun with its summer there, and no winter, because of the absence of its opposite, the sun.

sections.heading: Causes of Conflicts
paras: Colourlessness is the base of colours which is related to that world. do also peace is the base of warfare’s. Colourlessness of that world assumes colours in this world; and those things that bad peace between them, resort to fighting in this world. Thus, that world is the base of this world of sorrows and pains. So also, togetherness in unison is the base of all separations and destructions. Questions arises — these conflicts and oppositions are caused by what, and come from where, and also how unity come out of these opposing factors? This is for the reason that we are parts of the same base which is made of four opposing forces (elements) which together formed the base; and this has inculcated these conflicting forces in us. These four forces (elements) relate to this material world and create conflicts.

sections.heading: Soul: Cause of Unity
paras: At the same time there is the soul in us which is not from this world but from the other world, which brings about unity. This is because of the fact that the essence of the soul is different from these opposites as it is from God, and God’s essence is unity. Look at these conflicts and wars, which are bases and objects of peace, (and ultimately end in peace). You will see that the battles fought by the Prophet are for the cause of God which is to bring about unity. This is a wonderful fight the fundamental base of which is peace by crushing of mischiefs. He is fortunate who fights such a battle as it is for the sake of God. He is dominant and victorious in both the worlds, and it requires so many explanations and clarifications that no mouth can bring about.

sections.heading: Seek as Much as You Can from Math(s)navi
paras: However, as the entire water of the river Jaihun cannot be drawn by anyone, yet he should not severe his connections with it, and draw as much as is required to quench his thirst. What cannot be obtained in full cannot be discarded also in full. Therefore, if you are thirsty of the ocean of inner meanings. You should at least, roam about in the island of the meanings of the Math(s)navi. Roam about to such an extent that in every breath of yours may come about the capacity of seeing only its meanings and nothing more. When the straw accumulated upon the surface of the water is disturbed by wind, water shows its colourlessness. This is the case with Math(s)navi, if you keep the words away and look into the meanings. Look into the water of math(s)navi, and see branches of coral reefs and the fruits coming out of the water of life. You will ignore the letters, sounds and breaths and merge into the river of meanings, when the words, speaker and hearer — all the three roll up into one and become a soul. This is similar to the giver, receiver of bread and bread itself — all lose their shapes and become one unit of mud. But the meanings or souls each of them will remain in different states in different grades and in the matter of existence. Mud gets the physical shape but not the words and meanings. Words and meanings cease to appear like mud making to observer think that mud exists but not the meanings and soul. This is the observation in this material world. but in the spiritual world, all the three exist and are in wait, sometimes to get back to shape and sometimes without concern for the shape. Upon God’s command to get into a body, assume a shape, and at another command; they separate themselves from the body. This situation can be seen in God’s statement: His verity is all creation and command Alaa lahul khalqu wal amru: (A ‘raf: 7: 54).

sections.heading: Creation and Command
paras: That creation is by Him and so also, the command. Creation is of the body, and the command is the rider as soul upon the body. Both the rider and the body are together and under His command. Body is outside His court as it is material; and soul is within His court as it is independent and self-existing and can exist outside the body. Whenever He wishes that the water of life should enter into the pot, He commands, and water enters. Pot may be considered as body and soul as water. When He commands the armies of the souls to ride, they ride upon the bodies. And when He calls the souls to come down, He tells His announcers to command the souls to get down from the bodies. They get down from the bodies to ride up toward the world of spirits.

After explaining this much it is better that further elucidation is put an end to as there are many subtitles and refinements, which are beyond the understanding of the laity. Do not add further fuel to the fire and reduce the heat so that small cauldrons may not boil the contents so much that they spill out, as the cauldron of consciousness is very small and of low level. The coming into and going out of the body of the soul is too difficult for the realization of the common folk.

sections.heading: Difficult to Comprehend God
paras: God is beyond comprehension who sets up the apple gardens and hides them into the clouds of words. Pronouncement of letters, sounds of words and contents of sentences are so hidden behind these clouds in the form of thick curtains that they feel nothing but the fragrance of apples. When it reaches your sense of smell, you should take long breaths and inhale much with all your consciousness, so that this fragrance may pull you up and take you to the source of fragrance which is beyond the body of the apple. While doing so, you should protect this fragrance from the impacts of common cold which spoils your olfactory sense. Protect your body from the cold air and affairs of the common folk, so that your nostrils may not block and stop further breaths. The wind of the common folk is cooler than the winter winds. Their companionship causes great spiritual sicknesses. They go only by their physical bodies, and they are such frigid bodies that their breaths come out of the heaps of ice. When the earth of your body gets wrapped up in the shroud of this ice, hit it with the sword of the sun of Husamuddin. Draw out the sword of God from the east and hit it upon the body and warm it up. This sword of the sun of Husammuddin is neither from the east nor from the west. It is the riser up of the meanings of the unseen world, in the form of wise saints who hit their dagger upon the ice and melt it down the mountains and flow water toward the mud of the low-laying vallies.

sections.heading: Stars as Deciders of Fate?
paras: This is because this sun is not related to east or west, and it quarrels with the astronomer’s day and night asking him as to “why you have made the stars as the deciders of your fate and actions? Why you have made the unguided stars, instead of me, as your center of worship out of your meanness and blindness. This is to such an extent that you have not even considered the statement of the trustworthy prophet, H. Ibrahim who said as per the Quran: I do not love those who set: innii laa uhibbul aafiliina: (An ‘am: 6: 76). You have tied the belt of the rainbow around the waist of the sun, which makes you not to believe in the clefting asunder of the moon: warshaqqal qamaru (Qamar: 54: 1). You deny: when sun (with its spacious light) will be folded up: izaashamsu kuwwirat: (Takwiir: 81: 1). You consider sun to be very elevated and great as not to be folded up. You think that the winds change the courses because of the impact of the stars and therefore, you are unhappy to hear: By the star when it goes down: walnajmis izaa hawaa (Najm: 53: 1).
[Of course, there are benefits from the stars but considering them to be effective on their own is wrong].

sections.heading: Keys of Heavens and Earth
paras: The moon has its impacts, but it is not more than that of the bread, as there are many breads that have cut off the nerves of life. Venus is no more effective than water, as there are many occasions when water destroys the body. Your love for the stars has become your life and soul so much that any advice from a friend just touches the body and slaps off and rebounds from the ears. Our advice has no effect in this matter and therefore, you may know that your advice also has no effect upon us. The only means to change your mind is a special key coming from Friendly God as the keys of the heavens are his properties. To him belong the keys of the heavens and earth. Lahu maqaliidus samaawati wal ardhi (Zumar: 39: 63). What all I am telling is also like the moon and star, but it has no effect without a command from God. This star of advice has no dimensions as the other stars have and its impact is only upon those ears which search for inspiration from God, which tells them to come toward the dimensionless from the place of dimensions, so that the wolf of death may not tear you up. This dimensionless star is so bright that it spills bright pearls instead of rays, and the sun the sky feels like a bat to face it and avoids it.

sections.heading: Dimensionless Star of Soul
paras: The seven blue heavens are the slaves of this star, and the moon as an ambassador of the heavens suffers from fever and tuberculosis out of its fear. Jupiter has come and stood before it to offer all its possessions to it. Saturn has the desire to kiss its hand but finds itself unworthy of that grade. Mars which is considered as the executioner of the kingdom of heavens has its hands and feet injured and is lowly before it.h And Mercury, the writer of the heavenly, kingdom has broken a hundred pens because of it. All these stars are at war with the astrologer telling him: “you have ignored the life and soul of the invisible, dimensionless star and engaged yourself in observing the visible colours that dimensionless star is the life and soul, and we are all only its colours and shapes. Every thought coming out of it is like a star and life of all other stars. Where is this thought to be coming out of your mind and you are totally engaged with it, considering your self alone as a thinker.

sections.heading: Dimensionless Star of Soul
paras: Every star has its location in space, but our star of thoughts cannot occupy any location, as that star has limited mass, but the star of our thoughts has no limits of any kind. Soul which has no dimension cannot go toward any place. So also, the limitless light cannot have an end to get lost. Yet examples and resemblances of it are presented so that those anxious to know about it but have no competence to understand it may know a little of it. It cannot represent it as its symbol but as an example as a starting point to proceed to recognize its reality so that stagnant wisdom may proceed to think further. Man’s wisdom arising from the head is fast but his feet being slow to move, do not cope up with it, as physical body is quite smart and active of its own, but the heart and soul require extra nourishment and guidance to develop. But their untrained and unguided wisdom takes turns and twists in the transference of the worldly affairs from point to point and proceeds well. But in the matter of controlling the passions and desires, wisdom is very reluctant and slack. Man’s breast is very bright like the sun in making claims and complaining against others, but at the time of self-control and patience in respect of pious acts, it is so fast as lightning and remains out of control. He is like an entire world in itself with all its potentialities in the art of projecting himself in worldly affairs, but in respect of honesty and faithfulness, he is as unfaithful as the world. in the matter of feeling proud of himself, he is so large as not to be capable of being occupied in the large space of the world and gets lost within himself like the bread that gets lost in the gullet and stomach.

sections.heading: Lifeless Things Get Life Through Life
paras: All these vicious characters and conduct of man become good and appreciable for him when he gives them up. They cease to be vicious and despicable. When his egotism filthy like the semen gets connected with the soul instead of the bodily postures, it attains a light that makes it good. Every lifeless mineral upon entering into the plants becomes lively, full of life and fortunate. Every plant that turns toward its soul gets satiated with the life-giving water like H. Khizr and continues to live forever. And when the soul turns toward the soul of souls (God), it places itself and its potentialities in the never-to-come-to-end life.

chapters.title: Progress Is Man’s Greatness
chapters.subtitle: A person’s asking a preacher whether a bird sitting on fort wall has its head more valuable, nobler, honourable and respectful, or its tail. And the preacher’s answer to the questioner in accordance with his wisdom and capacity to understand

paras: A person said to a preacher: “Sir, you are of a higher level among those who stand on the pulpit. I ask you a question, wise one in this gathering. Please give an answer to this question. The head of a bird sitting on the top of a fort wall is better or its tail.” The preacher said: “if its face is toward the city and its tail toward the village, you may consider its head to be better than the tail. And if the tail is toward the city and the face toward the village, you may become the dust of its tail and avoid to look at its face.”

sections.heading: Man’s Greatness in Courage and Ambitions
paras: A bird flies towards tis nest because of its feathers, and man’s feathers are his courage and ambitions with which he flies high. A man in love involved in good and bad acts may not be looked at for these, but for his courage and ambition. A falcon may be white in colour and uncomparable. But if tis prey is a mouse, it is worthless. And if the owl’s inclination is toward the king, you may consider it to possess the head of the falcon, though not the headgear of the royal bird. A lion eating a dead donkey is a dog and look at it as such and not as lion. A dog pouncing upon the jaguar and wolf and chasing them away may certainly be considered as a lion.

Man is made up of a handful of dust, but his heart has gone far ahead of the heavens and stars. Man is made up of fistful of mud but is higher in level than the sky and the sphere of fire. The sky never heard the announcement: “We have honoured it as against as man thoughts full of sorrows heard, as stated in the Quran: We have honoured the sons of Adam; provided them with transport on land and sea: wa laqad karrmnaa banii adama wa hamalnahum fil barri wal bahr: (Asra’a: 17: 70). Has anything other than man presented itself before the earth, heavens of great worth with wisdom, ambitions and direct and indirect signals? It is you alone who have shown your face full of beauty, confidence and perfectness of wisdom boldly before the large expanse of sky.

sections.heading: Human Soul Greatness of Man
paras: O young man! Have you ever offered your silvery body to the beautiful paintings drawn on the walls of the bath. You pass away from before the hoor like beautiful paintings but prefer to present yourself before a semi blind old woman. What is it that is there in that old woman, which these beautiful paintings did not have, which has attracted your attention distracting from them? You may not say; but I shall say! What the old woman has is, wisdom, sense, consciousness, capacity to think and soul. She has in her the soul which can mix up all these qualities. The paintings of the bath do not have life and soul in them. If by chance, the paintings on the bath start moving about, they will take you away from hundreds of such old woman.

sections.heading: Angels Are Wisdom and Soul
paras: What is soul? This is something which is aware of good and bad. It is happy with graces and unhappy with pains. As it is aware of the secrets and qualities of good and bad, one who is more aware is more informed with the soul. As the search of the soul is for information, the more informed person is, the more powerful he is. One without soul is totally deprived of any wisdom and intellect. The world of souls is a world ofk information’s in entirety and one deprived of soul is totally devoid of any wisdom. More information’s have more impacts upon the soul and one possessing more information’s becomes godly and very near to God. Such of those who are devoid of any information, have the souls as lifeless as minerals. The first work of the soul is exposition of the attributes of God which is in fact, the exposition of God Himself. Composition of the angels was only wisdom and soul as though they were a body of wisdom and soul. But when a new soul of H. Adam came before them, they became obedient to him just as a body becomes obedient. They totally surrendered themselves to him just as the body becomes obedient to the soul. As a matter of great fortune for them, when they mingled with the soul of H. Adam, they became obedient to his soul just as his body was obedient to it.

sections.heading: Iblis: Disobedient Soul
paras: But as Iblis was rebellious to the soul of H. Adam, and he refused to be his obedient part. He got separated, and dead like a party of the body which upon separation dies. That was his great misfortune that he did not surrender himself to H. Adam. The broken arm could not obey his soul. It was his hand that broke but not H. Adam’s soul. It remained within H. Adam’s body. It could give life to the hand if it rejoined his body, but this did not happen. He undergoes the pain of failure to get the support of Adam’s soul. Though his hand lost Adam’s support his soul continues to exist, which works in its own different way. Yet there is another secret behind his disobedience. But there are no worthy ears to hear that secret. (This secret cannot be revealed to all and sundry). There is no parrot which can eat and digest this sugar of secret.

sections.heading: Unlooking of Secret
paras: There is plenty of sugar available for the special parrots, but ordinary parrots keep their eyes shut from this great food. How can one holding on to the door of the visible, physical objects taste this sugar of secrets written in the Math(s)navi. He does not go into the hidden meanings in it but only goes after its poetical rhythms. There is no prevention to the donkey of H. Isa from eating this sugar, but it is upon the nature of eating of grass. If sugar were to please the donkey, H. Isa would have spilled many bags of sugar before it. You may know the meaning of God’s statement from this point. The statement is: We set a seal on their mouths: Nakhtimu ‘alao af waahihim: (Yasin: 36: 65). Think over on this point well. This understanding is very necessary for a searcher of truth. Only worthy persons learn worthy things. Yet there is a possibility of finding a path toward this on the path of the last of the prophets (Muhammad). There is a possibility that this strong seal may be removed from the lips. Many earlier prophets, which the religion of Muhammad removed. There were many un-opened locks left out, which were unlocked by his hand as stated: Verily we have (opened) and granted you a manifest victory: Innaafahanaa laka fat-han mubinan: (Fatah: 48: 1). [Though this victory refers to the victory that H. Muhammad had on the Makkan infidels, yet it can also be referred to as the opening of the locks — Qazi sajjad Hussain]

sections.heading: Muhammad Unlocked Secrets
paras: He is an intercessor in this and that world. He is so in the matter of religion in this world, and in the opening of the gates of paradise in that world. This world tells him to show the path to the people and that world tells him to show the moon. It was his persistent prayer to clearly show the apparent and hidden aspects, and he always used to say: “O God provide guidance to my people as they are unaware.” With his prayer doors of both these worlds opened and his prayer was answered in both the worlds. It is because of this great grace that he is called as the “Seal of the Prophets” as there was none like him earlier, nor will there be in future. This is like your telling about a master, unmatchable craftsman that craftsmanship has ended upon him. He is the last among the prophets in opening up the seals and in the matter of providing spiritual excellence. He is the most generous ever in grevating the spiritual excellences to the people. To sum up, in the directions of Muhammad there are the meetings of all expectations. They are all openers within openers and within openers.

sections.heading: Spiritual Descendents of Muhammad
paras: Lakhs of lives sacrifice themselves upon his life for his grace, upon his contemporaries, and also upon those who come after him as his spiritual children. Those spiritual descendents of his who are accepted as great by everyone, who were all born out of his life and soul. Whether they are from Baghdad, Rey or Herat, they are all his spiritual descendants without any connection with the soil and water of their place of physical birth. Whenever the twig bearing flowers may be found, it brings about flowers. Wherever the vessel of wine may be found, its impacts are the same.

Even if the sun rises its head from the west, it is sun only in every respect and nothing else. O God, the Performer of all works, with Your great quality of hiding of defects, keep blind the finders of defects in my statements. God replied: I have shut the eyes of the ill-natured bat for all times from the unmatchable sun. Not only sun, from their lowly and worthless sight, even the stars are kept hidden.

chapters.title: Difficulty in Decision Making
chapters.subtitle: Condemnation of outdated honours that prevent the taste of faith, which evidence the weakness of truthfulness, deviating lakhs of foolish fellows from the right path. These are dacoits like that impotent fellow for whom the flock of sheep became a cause of fear making it impossible for him to pass though; and his telling the shepherd: “Your sheep are strange that they cause injury to me.” The shephard said: “if you are a man with the nerves of potency, they would sacrifice themselves for you. And if you are an ennuch each one of them is a python for you.” There is another ennuch who upon looking at the sheep turned back from them fearing to enquire, thinking that if he makes enquiries, the sheep will pounce upon him and tear him off

paras: Come nearer, o Zianul huq Husamuddin! You are the polisher of the soul and the king of guidance. Provide a wide field to this Math(s)navi and soul to the illustrations given in it, so that all its letters may become wisdom and soul in entirety and fly toward everlasting paradise. It is with your efforts only that these ideas have come from the unseen world of spirits and got imprisoned in the net of words. The wind of your life is like H. Khizr which encourages, supports and gives lasting life. You are like H. Khizr and H. Ilyas, who live for ever who are kept alive, so that this earth may become as large as the sky. I would have spoken of one percent of your grants, were I not to be afraid of the dominance and effectiveness of the evil eyes. But I do not dare so, because I have received many soul-scratching-wounds caused by poisonous water of the evil eyes. Therefore, I speak of your greatness only by referring to the events of others. Even this design is due to the treacheries that my heart has resorted to, because of which its feet are caught in slush.

sections.heading: Abu Talib’s Refusal to Change
paras: Hundreds of hearts have fallen in love with the Designer of the heart; and other hundreds of evils eyes and ears kept themselves away from Him. One such is Abu Talib, the Prophet’s uncle for whom the disapproval of the Arabs appeared as a terror. He feared as to what the Arabs would say: “if he gave up the faith relied upon by them upon the persuasion of his nephew H. Muhammad and also the honourable status received from ancestors. And that he lost he honourable path and went on the wrong path of Muhammad.” That especially chosen, virtuous Prophet, in order to provide deliverance said to his uncle to recite the article of faith (at least before him alone) he might take him as his follower to intercede for him, before God. But, he said: “this recitation would get a publicity and become known to all, as a secret that goes beyond two persons ceases to be a secret and becomes well known to all. All Arabs would talk of it, and my name would be on their lips resulting in my degradation before them. “Had there been a predecided grace upon him, there would have been no such fear in his mind.

sections.heading: Difficulty of Decision Making
paras: “O the Hearer of the complaints! You are a protector of those in distress; come to my support in the matter of the undecidable authority you have given to choose between two things. I am so much caught in the designs and treacheries of the heart that I am incapable of even lamenting upon them and upon indecisiveness. Who am I to lament upon it? Even the sky with its hundreds of engagements and powers has lamented upon its authority to decide praying to God: “O Generous, and Tolerant God! “Provide peace to me from this two-sided authority to decide. Inclination toward a single straight path is better than the confusion and anxiety of authority to take a decision when two conflicting ideas are in clash. Though You alone are the object of both these two ways, but this dual authority to me is life taking and very pain giving. Though the object of these two ways is none but You alone, but one is as hot and dangerous as a battlefield and the other is an abode of peace.”

sections.heading: Quran Speaks of Difficulty
paras: Know about this conflict and loggerheads from the Quran that this authority of decision making as a trust from God was rejected by the heavens, earth, and mountains, they refused to undertake it, being afraid thereof: Ashfaqnaa an yahmiluchaa (Ahzaab: 33: 72). This indecisiveness in the heart is like a battle in the heart. Is this better for me or the lack of it as in the case of heavens, earth and mountains. Conflicting ideas attack upon each other and there is a continuing struggle of hope and despair. “May there be a relief from this conflict, O God! Make our soul pleased with one decision.”

chapters.title: Desire for Authority and Pitfalls
chapters.subtitle: Supplications and seeking of Protection of God from the trial of the exercise of authority and from the trial of means of authority as the heavens and earth got frightened of the exercise of authority and feared about their means. But man’s instinct is after the increase of authority and the means of authority; as such, he regrets decrease of authority in sickness, and desires regain health as health is a means of authority with which his authority may increase. He desires for higher status as a means for increase in the exercise of authority. God’s wrath fell upon communities of the earlier periods who were dominant and honourable because of excessive authority and the means of authority. Nobody has seen a man behaving as Pharaoh in poverty and hunger.

paras: “O Generous, full of Majesty and benevolence, and of everlasting goodness, and Holder of the world; O everlasting king without deficiency in grants and always excessive in goodness; and Uncomparable in authority! I got this upheaval and subsidence of the soul from You alone, as otherwise. O Grand one, my soul was a peaceful ocean. Keep that place away from me which gave me these so many anxieties and fears and take them away with Your benevolence. I lament upon the trial in which You have entangled me which is such a trial before which dominant males are like subservient females. How long, my lord, do you continue this trial! Put an end to tis and show me one path to follow as against the ten paths that are before me. This choice of authority is such a load upon me as a heavy load upon the injured back of a weak camel. This heavy load at one time tilts toward one side and at times becomes heavier and pulls on the other side. Drop down this imbalanced load from my back so that I may smoothly go into and deed myself in the garden of the noble souls like the companions of the cave who in the garden of your generosity were not with the troublesome situation of wake life but in peaceful sleep. So that whether I am asleep on my right or on left side, I may turn this side or that. Without an authority of my own, like a ball. This is what you had done with them. You only turned them toward the right and the left side, O lord of righteousness!

sections.heading: Comforts Provided by Sleep
paras: For lakhs of years, I was flying in the open field of the souls of non-existence (‘Adam) like the particles moving about without any authority in the air. Though I have forgotten that state and time now, but my transference into sleep makes me recollect that situation, when I get rid of the torture of the four-nail-board (charmaikh) of life and the yoke of four pegs (charshakh). [these were instruments of torture for criminals. In (charmaikh) the criminal was tied on a wooden plank with his wrists and feet tied to nails. In (charshakh), a yoke with four pegs on four sides was put around the neck disabling him to put his head on the ground. These instruments of torture require to be seen in ancient museums and paintings — Translator]

Rid me of these pains and provide me the comforts and pleasure of this place of resting. I enjoy the taste of the milk that I had in my childhood from the wet nurse of my sleep which You provide, O my Lord of no concern for praise and worship! You provide this grant out of your great uncomparable generosity, which is similar to the free world of souls. This happens in my sleep, to get a little of it, all others in the world go to drinks with their own will and authority to lose their will and authority in wine. They resort to this dishonour of drinking and hearing of music in order to get rid of their power to exercise authority, because all the people know that this life is a net, and the capacity to think and to resort to exercise of authority is hell. They run away from their self-existence toward the loss of self-consciousness through intoxication with drinks and by engaging themselves in routine affairs.”

sections.heading: Temporary and Lasting Comforts
paras: But this state of self-forgetfulness through these means is short lived and temporary separation from worries as it is by artificial, external means. But the one caused by worship lasts for longer time as it is a natural product. Forgetfulness of the self should come from God, which is possible by one making oneself one with the beauty of the One God. It is impossible for men and jinns to run away from the limits and boundaries of time and space except with the promulgation of authority of the King of all though the holes created by Him in the high elevated heavens in space. There is no protection from other than this king of guidance from the harassment caused by the attacks of the shooting stars of misguidance, which are the guards on these holes of escape. All this is available for those saintly people to get themselves lost in the largeness of the court of the Great One as life of the lowly men lies in getting their own nothingness by getting lost by other mean ways. This is through the spiritual ascent of those who are as great as the heavens. This is nothing but getting lost, and conversion of the self into nothingness, which is the law and religion of the lovers of God.

sections.heading: Give Up Authority for Happiness
paras: You have already seen an example of this kind of resorting to nothingness in the case of Ayaz who had kept his torne leather-coat and sandals in his room, which was a niche of love for him. This he had done out of his sense of lowliness or nothingness. This was a result of his love for the king inspite of his being the beloved of the king. This was also for his possessing of his outer and inner qualities clean and well cleansed and in good state. He became one without any sense of self-pride, ostentation and self-assertion considering his own face as nothing but the mirror image of the king. This was because he had lost his own existence in the king resulting in all his acts becoming highly appreciable. This loss of himself was so consolidated in him that he was totally devoid of the fear of any kind of self-pride. He did not have the slightest extent of pride in him. He had so cultured himself and gone to such an extent that he cut off the neck of pride and self-consciousness.

sections.heading: Why Ayaz Looked at His Sandals
paras: Such being the case, why did he give importance to his torne leather-coat and sandals which related to his previous life? May be, he did so to teach others the means to lose self, or due to some other hidden wisdom which was devoid on any fear. Or looking at the sandals was necessary for him to attain perfectness in the matter of self-annihilation as he was not contented with what he had attained till then. Or this was to open the sepulcher, where the Zoroastrians used to seat the dead bodies smeared with scents considering them to be not totally annihilated, so that the wind of the secrets of life and death may be exposed. By opening of the sepulcher, the fragrance of the scents speared upon the dead bodies may reach the nostrils of the living. So that the death of the dead may provide a wind of fragrance for the pleasure of the living. That is to say the old torne leather-coat and the sandals made out of the leather of the dead animals preserved by him as trophies may send a message of life to others. The black dead leather has assumed the shape of a living coat and sandals as against his life, which had become blank by its annihilation in the king. The living-dead-coat and sandals might inspire life into those capable of receiving life who could feel the fine fragrance of annihilation.

sections.heading: Power and Money Reduce Wisdom
paras: Rulership of the world, wealth and beautiful garments are like chains that reduce the speed of their possessors. The soul of man looks at these gold chains and gets cheated, and from a vast field, he falls into the narrow passage of the well. The face of all these is beautiful like paradise but in reality, it is hellish — a snake full of poison but appearing like a colourful flower. Though this hell does not cause loss to a faithful man, yet it is better to bye-pass it. Though hell keeps itself away from him. Yet paradise is always preferable and better in every respect.

O defective people, be warned: Protect yourself from these beautiful faces, which appear hellish upon going closer! O reckless people, run away from this garden (of wealth and authority) as it is a furnace in reality and not a garden! Protect yourselves, O ignorant fellows! This is not a sweet compound of rose and honey. It is a spark of fire that burns your mouth. I tell you further! The apparent honey is a life-killing-poison! Keep yourself away from it. But you feel my advice bitter, and my warnings bring about sleep in you. O my friend! Wake up, at least for a little while, to enjoy the benefits of your life.

chapters.title: Strange Treatment of Illness
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of an Indian slave who was in love with the daughter of his master. When her marriage was settled with a rich man’s son, the slave came to know of it and fell sick and went on shrinking. Nobody could know the cause of his sickness and the slave was not bold enough to speak of it himself. Physicians were incapable of knowing the cause. When the master came to know of it, he made a design and cured him of illness

paras: There was a rich man who had an Indian slave, who was taken care of by him from his young age. He taught him good manners and gave him good education and brightened the lamp of arts in his heart. He was brought up from his childhood with all love and affection, by this generous man in his lap of benevolence. The master had a daughter, who was well cultured, beautiful with silvery body. When the girl attained puberty, there were many offers of marriage for her with heavy dowers. Every rich and noble man used to meet her father every moment for her hand for his son.

sections.heading: Good Conduct Best of Possessions
paras: The master used to say: “wealth does not have lastingness. It comes in the day and goes away in the night in every direction. Beauty also is not reliable as it becomes pale with the prick of a thorn. Being the son of a leader and rich man is also an ordinary matter, as he is always in pride of his father’s wealth and horses. There are many sons of the rich who with their misbehavior, mischief, and vicious acts are a matter of shame for their fathers. Even one with much knowledge and craftsmanship may not be considered good if he is of jealous nature. You can ascertain this from the case of Iblis. He had knowledge of all subjects but did not have love for faith. He saw nothing but mud in the shape of Adam. O trustworthy fellow! You may know many intricacies of knowledge, yet your tow eyes (physical and spiritual) may not open to see the hidden matters. Such a person sees nothing but the beard and turban. And mistakes one for a scholar and starts questioning about intricate matters about which one knows nothing. But who knows the realities is not in need of someone to tell him. He sees the realities of things himself as he is a bright light himself. Good things of this and the other world become known by pious acts and noble character and those only provide success in both worlds.

The master chose a son-in-law of noble character who was a matter of pride for the family and tribe. Women of his family said: “that boy does not have any wealth. He has no beauty, superiority and permanent status.” He told them: “these things are subordinate to piety and faith. This boy is a treasure of gold upon the face of the earth.”

sections.heading: Sickness of Heart
paras: When the news of the settlement of the girl’s engagement became known, and the ceremonial gifts were exchanged between the bride and bridegroom, the master’s slave, who was in his house fell sick and started becoming weak and thin. He went on shrinking in body like a one suffering from tuberculosis. Physicians failed to diagnose the cause of the disease. Commonsense said that he was suffering from the sickness of heart, and the medicines for the body are of no help in treating sickness of the heart. The slave also did not dare to speak out of the cause of his pain, even though his breast was full of injuries.

sections.heading: Lowly Fellow Desiring High
paras: One night the master told his wife to enquire about his condition in privacy. You are in place of his mother. There is a possibility that he might speak of his pains to you.” The wife seriously considered the suggestion. She went to the slave on the next day. She started combing his hair with two hundred affections, finenesses and friendliness, just as a loving mother does. In this manner she softened him, and he opened his mouth saying: “I did not expect you to give your daughter to an unknown, arrogant fellow! She is the daughter of my master, and I am broken hearted. Is it not a tragedy that she should go elsewhere?”

The lady felt so angry at this that she felt like trashing him and felling him down from the terrace of her house thinking: “as to who is this Indian, son of an ignoble mother, to have an eye upon the daughter of his master? But she said to herself that patience is better in this matter and so saying controlled herself. Then she told her husband: “Hear this strange report from me. We had never thought that our slave would be so mean and untrustworthy. We had considered him worth relying upon. He told me about his condition in such a manner, I got terribly upset and thought of killing him.”

chapters.title: Untested Grants
chapters.subtitle: The Master’s advice to his wife to have patience not to scold the slave. Without scolding, I shall prevent him from his greed in such a way that would need no fire to roast the meat nor the meat to remain raw

sections.heading: Pleasing Thoughts Make Man Healthy
paras: The master told his wife to have patience and tell the slave that we would disengage the girl and give her to him. With this, I might be able to eliminate her from his heart. Then you may see the fun as to how to get rid of the problem. You may please his heart and tell him that this is quite alright. In fact, our girl is the perfect match for you. We had not known that you wanted to take her. Now we have found out that you are more suited for her. Fire is ours and furnace also is ours. Laila is ours and Majnun is also ours. You may say this to him, so that he may be rid of anxieties and be in fond hopes. This pleasing thought will dominate him which will make him hale and hearty. Animals become fat by eating grass and man becomes fat with honour and nobility. Man becomes fat through words and ears, and animals becomes fat through the gullet and food.”

The lady said: “How can my tongue way in this mean and shameful affair in this manner, that I should talk of such a nonsense for the sake of that fellow’s health. It is better that, that untrustworthy devil dies.” The master said: “Do not hesitate and give him some relief so that with this pleasing talk he may regain his health. Write down my dear, of the responsibility of getting rid of him upon me. Wait for sometime so that this sharp injurer may regain health.”

When the lady gave this information to that broken hearted fellow, he felt so elated that he was not within the bounds of earth. He regained health, became fat and red in colour like the red lilac, expressing thousands of thanks. Sometimes he would say: “O my honouralbe lady! May not this happen to be a ruse and trick.” But the lady used to confirm and convince him that they were sure and certain on the matter. When the master saw that he has regained health, fatness and colour, and started moving about, he collected some people for a apprehended marriage of Faraj, (his slave’s name). the people played fool with him and complemented and greeted him. With all this, Faraj was so convinced that his sickness was totally eliminated from the roots. Then there was a further cheating when a young boy was dressed and decorated like a bride on his hands with henna as done to brides. A cock was shown to him as a hen. With bridal apparels and head covering as done with a bride, the manly face of that young, healthy strong boy was veiled and left both of them in the bridal chamber with lamps put off, in darkness and the slave was left with that strong boy alone. The strong boy took the slave in his strong arms and strongly compressed him so much that he started shouting and crying, but his cries could not reach others overtaken by the loud sounds of the tambourines, clapping’s and loud sounds of men and women outside the bridal chamber. That young boy went on thrashing and pressing the slave till the morning like a hungry dog which gets angry, thrash and tears a bag full of flour as it provides no food for it. Then he was provided with water for washing other ceremonial wearing materials and Faraj entered the bath. He was very tired and in pains, his anus torne like the garments of furnace firemen.

sections.heading: Love Turns into Hate with Pain
paras: He came out of the bath and sat down under the shamiana, and master’s daughter sat before him in bridal apparel. Her mother sat by her side as a guard so that he may not see her well and find out that she is different from the one with whom he had spent the night. He looked at her for a moment with hateful eyes and pushed her down with both hands and said: “may not God make anyone a husband of a vicious bride like you. During the daytime your face is beautiful like the women of Khotan (a city of China) and at night, you are like the one horned rhinoceros. During the day you are beautiful Tatari women and in the night, you have a penis more piercing than that of the donkey.” This is how all grants of the world appear beautiful from a distance well before testing. From a distance what appears like water and upon going nearer it is only a mirage. It is like an old haggard treacherous woman who shows herself as a young fresh bride. Be careful not to be cheated by this artificially made-up beauty and do not taste its honey full of poison, so that you may not be caught in a hundred difficulties like Faraj. Have patience, as patience is a key of all comforts. The world is a grain hidden in a net and its grants appear pleasing to you in the initial stage.

chapters.title: Getting Tricked Is Common
chapters.subtitle: To explain that the Hindu slave was not the only one to be trapped in tricks, but every man gets involved in such tricks in every matter, except the one protected by God

sections.heading: Carry Burdens of Others
paras: Be careful before getting trapped in the net, because you get trapped, no amount of crying will be of use. In leadership, , ministership and kingship are hidden death, pain and sacrificing of life. Be humble and move on the land like a horse and not like the bier containing the dead body that is carried on the shoulders of others. the thankless rejector of truth wants to ride upon others, but becomes a burden for others like the dead body. The interpretation of one being seen in a bier in the dream is that he will get an elevated position, as his bier is on the shoulders of others, just as the burdens of the powerful are put upon common people. Therefore, be careful my son, to put the burden of your body upon yourself and not upon others. Protect yourself from this thing. That is, do not try to go for leadership and domination. It is better for you to lead the simple life of a recluse than the life of pomp and pageantry. Do not ride upon the necks of others so that you may not feel the pain of gangrene in your toes. The vehicle upon which you ride initially appears like a beautiful city but ultimately turns into a ruined village, from which you will pass out with great difficulties. Push it away from yourself now, when it appears like a city so that you may not finally settle in a ruin. Push it away when you are strong, having a hundred gardens, so that you may not become weak and a worshipper of ruin.

sections.heading: Ask Everything from God
paras: The Propeht has said: if you want to ask for paradise from God, do not ask for anything from anybody else. If you do not ask others I shall assure you of the Garden of Abode, the paradise in which you live from where you see God (Jannatul Maawaa). This is what the Prophet has said to his companion Hakim ibne Hazzm also. This companion so much relied upon this assurance that he never asked anyone for anything to such an extent that when once he was on the ride, and his whipcord fell from his hand, he did not ask any passerby to pick it up for him but got down and picked it up himself. This is because: when someone relies upon God, he does not seek from others knowing well that God will meet his requirements.

sections.heading: Asking for God’s Sake
paras: However, if something is sought from others for the sake of God, it is permissible as that was the practice of prophets. [even asking others to follow the path of God, is seeking their indulgence, which all prophets did]. When God has given hints to you in indirect manner to seek help from others, there is no wrong in it so long as it is for the sake of God. Even a statement of denial of faith of God, if it is for the sake of God; becomes a matter of faith. Even vicious impermissible acts which are actually done in good faith to meet the spirit of His commands becomes much better that all other right and permissible acts. Do not ignore the pearl hidden in a damaged oyster, as there are thousands of pearls hidden in damaged oysters. There is no end to these talks. March on towards the hidden realities and know the truths so that you may sit like the trained falcon sitting upon the wrist of the king.

sections.heading: Forgetfulness Causes Silence and Loss of Pain
paras: Return to the gold mine of God after getting purified, so that you are not transferred from hand to hand for your worth. As gold outside the mine, you will be of use for others, but it will suffer by passing from hand to hand. Your should know that you are more valuable in the place of your origin in the abode of God. An ugly face and a worthless thing initially given a place in the heart will be shamelessly chased away later. The thief suffering the punishment of the severance of hand, keeps the taste of thieving away just as women express their resentment not by words but with the shake of their hand. You may also look at the way of those in grief expressing their grief with the shake of hand. The thief losing his hand has no hand to shake to express his grief, yet he does so with his wrist. Similarly, cheats, murderers, and rowdies forget the pleasures of comforts in times of sufferings. They go on repenting again and again like moth falling on lamp. But after sometime, forgetfulness drags them all towards itself, just as the moth forgets its pain of burning of the first occasion when it had mistaken fire as light and hence towards it. Ultimately when its wings burn out, it falls down like a helpless baby who, in order to divert the attention from pain, is told: “Oh, you have deliberately felled your salt.

sections.heading: Man Recollects and Goes Forward Again

But Man Out of His Greed for Gains, After Sometime of Regret and Repentance, Goes Toward His Wrong Acts Again and Runs Towards Difficulties Like the Moth Toward Fire. He Goes on Doing These Acts Again and Again. When Ultimately, He Loses All His Possessions and Hopes, He Dashes upon the Lamp and Totally Ignores It Just as the Indian Slave Did with His Beloved Telling: “O Lamp, Your Face Brightens the Dark Night Like the Moon, but You Are an Unfaithful, Lying Friend, Arrogant and Cause of Burning.” Then He Finally Forgets All His Pains and Memories of the Past, as God Has Said That He Causes Weakness to the Cheatings of the Falsifying Infidels: Annaltaha Mishinia Kaidal Kaafiruun:: (Anfaal: 8:18)

chapters.title: Fire Burns and Itself Burns Out
chapters.subtitle: To explain the large expanse of the meaning of the verse: everytime they kindle the fire of war God extinguishes it: Kullamaa awqaduu naaran lilharbi atfaahallahu: (Maida: 5: 67) A narrative to explain this meaning

paras: Whenever they kindled the fire fo war, Allah extinguished it totally obliterated it by determining fully that it has no place to exist, and it forgets everything about itself, as fire does not have a willingness of its own. As fire did not sow the seed of truthfulness on its own. Allah imposed upon it forgetfulness. [This is so with the heart of the enemies of God. They start fire somewhere and forget about other places from where processes of extinguishment fall on the fire started by them]. They keep their hearts entirely dependent upon the power of flint and fire, but they forget that God’s had extinguishes fire.

A thief entered into the house of a nobleman at night stealthily and silently like a wolf. The nobleman heard the slow sound of the steps in the darkness and picked up his flint and rubbed it in order to light the lamp to ascertain clearly the secret behind the light sound. The thief came inside and sat before him, and as soon as the wick of the lamp caught fire, pinched it with his fingers so the spark may not become fire. He used to wetten the tip of his finger to extinguish the fire. The house owner thought that the fire was getting extinguished of its own without seeking that the thief was putting it out. He said to himself: the cotton to catch fire is wet which results in its not catching fire. As there was total darkness in front of him, he did not see the fire extinguisher sitting before him.

sections.heading: Nothing Occurs on Its Own
paras: In this manner, the infidel and heart-blind does not see the entinguisher of fire in his heart, because of his blindness. Such being his darkness, he does not see that there is someone who is moving everything that is moving around. So also, why do you not say that the days and nights are alternating with the commands of God. You go around the reasons and causes behind events and refuse to see that the reasons and causes behind yourself. Think over: whether a house built by an expert engineer is better or the one built by one ignorant of the skill? Can a large, worthy house come about without a good engineer? Any writing is the result of the work of a writer. Can it come about without a writer? How can the different shapes of letters like those of circles, ellipse and lines come about without a good writer? Can we see the lamp lit on its own without someone lighting it? can good craftmanship come from a man without eyes and hands or from an expert with bright and keen eyes? This should make you know that certain powers, qualifications and abilities hit their maces upon your head to make you do certain specific acts. Therefore, resort to a war against this thought that things and results come about on their own. Shoot your arrows towards these thoughts just as Nimrud shot arrows all around in the air. Or like armies of the Mongols, shoot your arrows towards the sky, which ultimately take a turn and hit at their own armies in front of them. This is how you should make wanton attacks on the enemies of your senseless thoughts. Or you may run away from the enemy. But, of course, you cannot run away as you have pledged yourself to these thoughts. You are not free!

sections.heading: No Running Away from God
paras: You were once in the world of non-existence (‘adam). You had not yet come into existence. Even then you were under the grip of God. You were not free. When that was the case then, how can you go out of His hold when you are so well organized bodily in physical appearance. Getting out of His hold is different, you cannot even desire and think of it, because thinking and desiring is like mentally running away. This too, you cannot do, as doing so is running away from justice and fighting against what is rightly provided to you. This world is like a net and desire is like a grain spread upon the net. Therefore, keep yourself away from this net and grain of greed and desire. If you run away from them, you will see many reliefs and expansive fields, where you will keep yourself opposed to desires and greed, where everything will be in consonance with you.

It is through the opposites of things that the truth of things becomes clear in appearance. In order to know the truth of a thing, engage yourself in its opposite. Things can be recognized well through their opposites. This is possible only through your own efforts and not through hearsay.

sections.heading: Right Decisions: Only from Heart
paras: Decisions coming from your heart are the right decisions. That is why the noble Prophet said: “Seek the verdict from your heart, even though there may be very learned jurists speaking of very intricate and keen arguments. Hear the verdict of your heart, even if a jurist tells you very many things. Give up your desires, so that God’s mercy may come upon you. I have tested this formula and I find it to be right.

When it is not possible to run away from what is already decided by law, it is better to obey it, so that you may find this free obedience as a garden which takes you away from the restraints of the prison of desires and efforts of escape. As you think over well on this matter, you will find yourself rid of confusion, and see God as doing all justice to you. Be sure that just because you have shut your eyes behind the curtain, sun will not stop its motions.
Now let us go again towards Ayaz and his state in the perfectness of the height of his achievements and excellence.

chapters.title: Sufficient and Insufficient Information
chapters.subtitle: The King’s demonstration to the nobles and opponents about the status and excellence of Ayaz; and his own nearness to him; and grant of expenses for his garments, in such a way that there be no arguments and objections thereon

paras: When the nobles of the court were full of jealousy, they made remarks upon the king himself saying: “this Ayaz of yours does not have thirty times wisdom, but why does he get the salary equal to thirty nobles?”

The king went with the thirty nobles towards the forests and hills for hunting. He saw a caravan from a distance and said to one of the nobles to go to the caravan and enquire as to from which place, they have come. He went, made enquiries, and said: “they are coming from Rey.” He asked the noble as to where they intend to go. The noble had no answer. He told the other noble to go and enquire as to where they intend to go. He went and returned and said: “they are going toward Yemen.” He asked the noble as what goods they were carrying? The noble was taken by surprise and had no answer. The kind asked another noble to go and make enquiries about heir goods. He came back and said: “they are carrying all kinds of materials, and in particular vessels made in Rey”. The king asked him as to when they had departed from Rey and the noble had no answer. Then the king asked another noble to enquire as to when they departed from Rey. He came back and said that they had left Rey on the eighth of Rajjab. Then he asked him about the cost of materials in Rey. As this noble did not know of it, he held his breath, and the king sent another noble for this purpose.

In this manner these thirty and still more nobles were inefficient in going and coming back to get sufficient information in going and coming back to get sufficient information. Everyone was only after one question that the king had asked. None was able to get full information. Then the king told them: “in similar manner, I had tested Ayaz once to enquire as to of place was a caravan. He went and brought back all necessary information about all matters, without my telling and even giving a hint, he made all enquiries in full clarity and brought back the results. What all could be ascertained from thirty nobles on thirty different occasions, he got in one attempt and provided to me.

chapters.title: Testing of the Wisdom of Nobles
chapters.subtitle: Appeal of the nobles to the king to reconsider his opinion on the matter in the manner of the predestinarians and the king’s reply thereon

paras: The nobles submitted their argument to the king that: “this ability of Ayaz is an art and a gift of God. There is nothing to do to get this by man. This is not a result of efforts. God has granted a beautiful face to moon and also fragrance to flowers. But when the king blesses and grants, the grantee pitches his tent upon the moon with great pride.”

The sultan said: “this is not correct. These qualities do not come into man on their own. They are the product of avoidance of wrongs and on cultivation by efforts. As otherwise, H. Adam upon his disobedience would not have accepted his wrong and said: “O Lord! We have wronged our own souls”: Rabbana zhalamnaa anfusanaa: (A’raaf: 7: 23). He would have said: “this wrong has occurred because of Your own making as this has been pre-destined to happen as such our efforts to avoid it would be of no use. “This kind of statement would have been like that of Iblis who said: (This happened) “because you have thrown me out”: bimaa aghwaitanii: (A‘raaf: 7: 16). You only broke the cup, and you are beating me!”

sections.heading: Explanation of Free Will (Authority)
paras: Rather, determinism by God is true and so also the efforts of man. Do not become one-eyed like the old devil. You may see that man remains undecided when two ideas strike his mind at one time. How can this lack of prompt decision arise if he has no free will? This lack of prompt decision arises because of his free will to choose one of them. He would not have remained undecided to do this or that, if both his hand and feet are tied up rendering him helpless. He never remains undecided on a thought, such as: whether he should fly in the air or walk on the sea (as these are impossible). But he remains undecided whether to go to Mosil or to go to Babylonia to learn magic. This shows that thinking about doing this or that is due the authority he has in choosing one of them. Without authority there is no scope of choice. Thinking of choosing without authority to choose is funny. Therefore, you should not plead of lack of authority while thinking of actions and push the blame of your inaction upon fate. This is like saying that X caused murder and punishment is to be imposed upon Y. A should drink wine and the B should be punished for it. Go around yourself and find out your own wrongs. Consider the movements as of your body and not of your shadow.

If you are punished for your wrongs, you should accept it and not blame the judge, who knows and finds out the offenders as He is not blind. You alone will get fever if you eat honey. The wages of your labor for the day will not be paid to another in the evening. There is nothing which you have not received when you have put efforts for it. What you have sowed will be certainly reaped by you.

sections.heading: Connection Between Acts and Results
paras: Your acts which originate from yourself will hold on to you like your children. In the invisible world of laws, acts assume shapes different from laws. A man is not hanged for the crime of theft on the scaffold. Theft has no similarity with scaffold. Yet, God the knower of all unseen things has provided a particular shape in this world for a particular act. He has put a particular shape in the mind of the judge for a particular wrong in order to meet the ends of justice. If you are aware of law and acts as judge, you cannot impose an unsuitable and illegal punishment. When you, as an ordinary judge, do not do in this manner, how can the supreme judge of all judges act differently? When you sow millet, no other crops other than of millet will come up. When you have borrowed the money, how can anybody else’s property be attached? Therefore, do not blame another for your wrongs; and be sure to watch with your eyes and ears for the reward for it. Put the blame of sin upon yourself as you alone have sown the seed and be ready to be in consonance with the reward and punishment from God. Your own wrongs act cause pain to you as punishment. Consider them to be the cause and not your fate.

sections.heading: Reliance upon Fate Causes Laziness
paras: Relying upon fate makes your eyes defective. It makes a man lazy and go after filth like the dog. Blame yourself for your wrongs and not the punishment provided for wrongs. Repent for your sins and go on the straight path like a bold man and know well that whoever does an atom’s weight of good or bad acts will see them in the ultimate end. Do not allow yourself to fall into the treachery of your vicious self, as the sun of truth will not hide from sight even so little as an atom. Know well for your own profit that the particles of your body are quite visible to the sun of your entire body. Particles of your thoughts and inclinations are quite clear to the sun of truths. They are quite clear before God though hidden from you. However, this is a hidden secret which is very difficult to understand; and do not try to go deeper into it.

chapters.title: Extreme Poverty May Lead to Infidelity
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the hunter who had wrapped himself with grass and kept a bouquet of flowers and lilac upon his head like a cap, so that birds might mistake him for grass. And of the smart bird which found out a little about him as man posing himself as grass. But it did not know of the trick in full; yet became arrogant as it was not confident of primary indepthness but relied upon secondary thought as final, particularly as it happens at the time of the excessiveness of greed and need. The noble Prophet, may praise be upon him and upon his truthful companions has said: “extreme poverty is very nearer to fell one into infidelity”

sections.heading: A Bird Went into a Garden, and There Was a Trap Laid by a Hunter. He Had Spread Some Grains on the Ground and Hidden Himself in Wait for the Prey. He Had Wrapped Up Himself with Grass and Leaves with a Cap Made of Flowers and Lilac on His Head. He Was Sitting in Wait for Some Bird to Fall in His Trap Under Misguidance
Pleasing Words of Cheats
paras: Unaware of the design, a bird came over there, took a flight around the hunter and went toward him. It asked: “who are you, O the one in green dress, in this forest among the beasts?” the hunter said: “I am a godly man. I have discarded the world remaining contented with grass and leaves. I have made piety and discarding of world as my faith and religion, as I see death very much before me. The death of a neighbor became my preacher, which made me give up my business and home, as I am ultimately going to be lonely; and I should not have the conduct usual of men and women. I shall, in the end go toward the grave, and it is better that I should be alone with God, who is all Alone. You should know my dear, when my chin will be tied up with a piece of cloth around my head after my death to prevent it from falling down and open the mouth. It is better that during my life time also I keep my mouth shut.

sections.heading: Do Not Forget the Origin
paras: “O the one accustomed to wearing soft, colourful-silk-garments and waistbands, know this, that your end also is the wearing of unsewn plain sheet of shroud. We are all to go towards mud as we originated from it, but we have developed relationship with those in the world who will not accompany us after death. Our original grand parents and real relatives are the four elements (air, water, fire and earth), but, out of greed, we have established relationship with temporary things. For years together man’s body remains in the company and friendship of these elements. But his real spirit is with the soul and wisdom; and spirit remains in forgetfulness of its fundamental base. The base of man before coming into existence that the elements themselves. When the spirit ignored its connection with the absolute soul and absolute wisdom, a message come to the soul: O unfaithful! You have turned your face from your old friends just because, you got some new friends from the world of a few days.

“You are like the children who are engaged for the whole day in play and at night they are dragged by their towards the homes. While playing, a child removes his clothes and shoes and keeps them aside and thieves take them away. He is so engaged in the games that the thought of the clothes and caps vanish completely from his mind. Evening arrived and other players left one by one and having lost his clothes he has no face to go home. You fall in such a situation. Have you not heard: the life of the world is but play and amusement: Annamal hayaatud dunyaa la ‘ibunwa lahwan: (Hadiid: 57: 20). You also lost all your possessions and fell into fears like the child. Therefore, before arrival of the night (of death) search for your clothes and do not waste your time in useless talk.”

sections.heading: Protect Your Right of Repentence
paras: So saying generally, the hunter continued to say: “I have resorted to seclusion in the forest. I have considered the people of the world as thieves on my clothes. I spent half of my life in the desire of lovable things and the other half in quarrels with the enemies. One fellow took away my shirt and other took away my cap, when I was immersed in the game like a young boy.

Death will come over like the evening and therefore I should stop playing and prepare to go home. Be careful! Ride on the vehicle of repentance and go to the thief (of death) and take back your clothes from him. Vehicle of repentance is a very strange vehicle in its swiftness. In an instant it goes from the lowly world towards the sky. But be careful to protect this vehicle from the thief who has stolen your clothes, as otherwise he may steal your vehicle (of repentance) also. Be careful to protect this vehicle at every moment from this devilish thief.

chapters.title: Theft of Sheep and Clothes Too
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of a person whose ram was stolen by a thief. But the thief was not satisfied with the ram and with a trick he stole that person’s clothes too

sections.heading: Fools Get Cheated Easily
paras: A person had a ram which he was dragging behind. A thief cut off the rope of the ram and took it away. When the owner came to know of it, he searched on the right and left to know as to where the stolen ram was taken away. Then he saw the thief with the ram on the mouth of a water well, wailing and shouting: “what am I to do! I have been destroyed”. That fellow asked him: “what is the matter, O master! Why are you wailing”. He said: “My purse containing my cash fell into the well. If you can remove it from inside the well, I shall give one-fifth my money in it to you will all pleasure. There are five hundred dirhams in my purse. With the blessings of your help, you may take one-fifth of the contents. That is, you may take one hundred dirhams.” That fellow thought: “this is the price of ten rams. One door shut and hundred doors opened. One ram goes and God gives me a camel instead.” So thinking, he removed his clothes and entered into the well and the thief instantly took his clothes too and ran away.

One has to be wise and perfect enough to pass on the way to one’s village. If there is no perfectness of wisdom, one will get the sickness of plague. In similar manner, Satan, the mischievous-master-thief comes to you every moment in the form of various thoughts. No body can know of his tricks except God; and therefore go to the refuge of God to protect yourself from this great thief.

chapters.title: Monasticism Negated in Islam
chapters.subtitle: Debate of the bird with the hunter on monasticism and the meaning of monasticism as the noble Prophet Muhammed has prohibited monasticism for his followers saying: there is no monasticism in Islam

paras: The bird told the hunter: “Do not resort to monasticism seclusion. It is not good thing in the religion of Muhammad. The last on to this innovation like a senseless fellow. Friday prayer is duteous, and this has to be done in congregation. There is no Friday prayer in loneliness. So also, the command for good acts and prevention of the vices. Bearing with the pains given by the vicious people comes under the noble act of patience which has to be followed and also providing benefits to the people like clouds. It is also stated in hadith(s): “best of the men is one who benefits them”. You can be a friend of lumps of mud only if you are stronger than them like a stone. Be in the midst of the community of the blessed Prophet, and do not ignore his practice but be its follower.
