He has further said: “community life is benevolent and secluded life is a torture.” Try to seek benevolence from the community and keep it as a crown upon your head.”

sections.heading: Types of Seclusion
paras: To this, the hunter said: “think over that this is not so, as you say in absoluteness. It is relative to persons and circumstances. Loneliness is better than the company of vicious friends. A noble person sitting along with vicious fellows also becomes vicious, as the one with immature wisdom is like a stone and lump of mud, in a wise man’s view. One without abilities is like a donkey and living with him is as good as seclusion. His senses are entirely towards fodder like those of the donkey. Run away from him so that you may also not be disabled. Everything other than God is going to be shattered into particles. Everything that arrives now, passes into past in the very next moment. Everything other than Him is destructible. Countries and their masters are only the shadows of that Absolute Master. Though the shadow of a person is exactly similar to him, but you get nothing from the shadow. Try to search God through His shadow, as everything is His shadow. Think of the causer and not of the cause. The physical face of a friend is towards death and such a friend is inauspicious and requires to be discarded. As this friend with destructible body goes after destructible object, his opinions and commands are also destructible. Rather, as he is a searcher of the dead, consider the searcher of the dead as dead. One who remains in the company of such people is also like the one living in seclusion. He is like one in the company of the lifeless like lumps of mud and stones. You should go away from these lumps of mud and stones and of toward the mine of rubies. These lifeless stones and lumps of mud are also dacoits. Lakhs of troubles are better than these miserable lifeless objects.”

sections.heading: Fighting Against Unrighteous Is Better
paras: The bird argued: “the question of Jihad and struggle to counter arises only in situations where there are dacoits on the way. There is no question of Jihad when there is no enemy. In order to give protection, help and fight, a brave, lion-like-man enters into frightening roads. The nerve of manliness becomes active, when a traveler is along with the enemies. The noble Prophet is called as the prophet with the sword and therefore, his followers should be brave and rank-breakers of the vicious and enemies. Fighting against the rejectors of truth is for establishment of peace and grandeur of noble fighters; but in the religion of H. Isa, it is hillocks and caves. God has shown different means of peace to different people. Search for such a peace by fighting against the vicious by remaining along with them, not by running away from them.”

sections.heading: Friends Need to Fight Enemies
paras: The hunter said: “what you say is right provided that there is sufficient strength and support, so that with this combined might there can be an attack on mischief and temerity. In this path manly strength is required and also sincere friends to be one with each other like one man. It is better to be away from troubles when there is no strength. It is easy to run away from danger in a situation of helplessness. This only is the proper approach, my dear friend! Think over on this point and also about the final result! Search for a friend who knows to find the proper way, as otherwise what can you understand about the road and the wells.”

sections.heading: Sincerity Provides Supporters
paras: The bird replied: “what is most required is sincerity in the job, as there are many friends and supporters for the sincere. If you are considerate towards others, you will see countless number of friends, as without friends, you will be totally helpless. Your enemy is like the wolf, and you are like H. Yusuf. Do not discard the lapel of H. Yakub and be with him. The wolf becomes a catcher of the young lamb, when it is away from the flock. One who gives up the practice of the prophet and remains away from the community drinks his own blood in the forest of wild beasts. Followership of the Prophet is like the way and community is like co-travellersl without proper way and co-travellers, you will be caught in difficulties. The path shown by the Prophet along with the community is certainly better just as a horse walk better while walking along with other horses.

sections.heading: Bold, Wise and Well-Informed Friends
paras: But be careful and do not consider the misguided as a good co-traveller. Do not consider those in sleep as well informed. Search for a co-traveller who can be of help, who should be of one heart with you, sympathetic and searcher of God. Not the fellow who is an enemy of wisdom, who would remove your clothes upon getting an opportunity, who would loot you in difficult narrow passages in the hilly tracks. Who would be with you only for his own gains? Be warned! Do not taste the honey he gives as it is a fang full of poison in it. He should not be a coward who out of fear would teach you the lesson of retreat from the way in difficult circumstances and frightens the friend out of his own cowardice. Consider such a companion as an enemy. He cannot be a friend.

sections.heading: Path of Faith Not for Cowards and Weak
paras: “a bad companion is a snake! Be careful and run away from him, so that he may not inject the poison of misconduct in you. Such a fellow misguides a companion on the way. One who sleeps under a woman, dominated by her cannot be a perfect man. Bravery is the proper way in every path of life and a proper means to chase away the weak-hearted. How can a misguided fellow pass on the path of faith on his own? A brave perfect guide is required to show the proper path. The path of faith is full of difficulties and risks of the reason that it is not meant for every coward and weak fellow. There are many tests and trials on it for the souls to separate the worthy and others just as the sieve is meant to separate the flour from husk. That way is right on which are the marks of the footprints of earlier successful travelers. And a real co-traveler is one who is a ladder of good ideas which promote you step by step.

sections.heading: Community Gives Strength
paras: “I agree with you that the wolf will not catch hold of you, if you are careful, but still, you cannot enjoy the pleasure of safety without the community. You may know that, though the donkey is a senseless creature, but when in the company of other donkeys, it becomes happier and stronger. A donkey that goes alone on the way being away from the caravan, feels the way to be hundred times harder and painful. It receives more beatings and pricks while travelling alone with the master in the forest. That donkey tells you: “Be careful if you are not a donkey, not to travel alone. The one who walks very well even in loneliness, certainly walks better when in the company of others. That is why, inspite of being perfectly true, every prophet exhibited miracles to search companions to proceed easily on his path.

“If every wall remains unconnected with other walls, there cannot be a roof suspended in the air. There cannot be a house to reside and go down to stock. If the pen and ink do not go together, how can there be a writing on paper. A mat is made with the bringing together of the date leaves. If they do not come together, they will be flown away by the wind. God has created pairs in every species, through whom He proceeds further to create more pairs, which form a group of their own.”

These arguments went on between the hunter and the bird creating many difficult to-answer-questions, until the night arrived. He said something and it said something else in a hot debate, and the discussion increased. Therefore, let me put he Math(s)navi in motion and make it pleasing by reducing the debate and each other’s arguments.
Greed destroys all logic

But when the eyes of the bird fell on the grains of wheat, its desire and greed went beyond control out of joy. Then it asked the hunter as to for whose purpose are the grains of wheat there? The hunter said: “they are the trust of a child for whom no will is made by the ancestor. These belong to the orphans and are in trust with me as I have been taken as trustworthy.” The bird said: “I am in distress and torn up. Even a dead animals flesh is permissible for consumption in such a situation for me. Would you permit me to eat these grains, O trustworthy pious and honorable!”

The hunter said: “You alone have become the judge for this judgement in the case, out of necessity. And you feel that, if you eat without permission in absolute need, you will not be a sinner. Even if there is an absolute need, it is better to avoid and if you eat without permission, you will be obliged to give damages. At this the bird sank within itself. Its horse of greed did not come under control inspite of drawing fast of the reins. As soon as it eats the grain, it got trapped in the net. In order to get out of it, it recited the surats of Yasiin and Al-An‘am very much, but it was all in vain.

sections.heading: Regrets and Sighs of the Event
paras: What is the good of regrets and sighs after getting caught? The black smoke ought to be earlier, well before the grain became a net for you and the heat of your greed became cold like ice. Sighs, smoke and lamentations had to be resorted to earlier to eliminate the impacts of greed. When greed and desires come into motion, the only way left was to call upon God. That was the time well before the city of Basrah was pillaged. There would have been a scope for the avoidance of defeat of Basrah there. Any effort after the defeat is of no use.

O crier and O misguide! Cry upon me well before the destruction of basrah and Mosil. Cry upon me well before my death and seek for my pardon, and do not cry upon my death, but have patience. Cry upon me before my destruction and loss and stop crying after the coming of the deluge of destruction.
Yasiin reguines to be recited when Satan becomes a dacoit. Beat your drum of warning and caution well before the spoilage of the caravan, O guard of the caravan! And not later!

chapters.title: No Drum Beating After Loot
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the guard who was silent when goods of the merchants were looted, when thereafter started crying and guarding

paras: There was a guard of a caravan. He was the guard for the goods and properties of the rich merchants of the caravan. One night he went into sleep and the thief took away the materials from the camp and buried them under the ground. When the day arrived all the people woke up and found that gold, silver and camels were no more there. The guard started wailing and beating the drum. In fact, he was himself the thief.

He was asked as to where the goods and materials have gone? He said: “thieves came with veils on their faces and took away the materials right before me.” People asked him: “O heap of sand grains! What were you doing? What kind of a useless fellow you are? He said: “I was alone, and they were in large number, with weapons bravery and domination. They said: “if there was no scope for you to fight, you should have shouted upon us to get up.” He said: “they threatened me with swords and daggers to keep quiet as otherwise they would instantly kill me. Therefore, I kept my mouth shut at that time out of fear; and now I am shouting crying and lamenting. At that time my breath had stopped me from shouting. Now I shall cry as much as you want.”

sections.heading: Repentance Before God Is Different
paras: When the disgraced devil has taken all your senses for your whole life, what is the good of reciting.” O God I seek refuge! And all praises are for God.”

These recitations are tasteless now. However, though crying now is tasteless, but ignoring these recitations is still worse. That is to say repentance is good even in the fag end of life. Therefore, be making these tasteless cries and pray to God to: “cast a look on the worthless fellows. You are mighty every moment. There is no earlier time or later time for You. No time is lost for You. Every time is the same for You. Though You have told us: You may not despair over matters that pass you by: La taasafu ‘alaa maa fatakum: (Hadiid: 57: 23).”
But how can what we seek, be hidden from His great authority. His advice is not to despair upon what you lost and not upon what I lost.

chapters.title: Pleading of Goodness Before the Vicious
chapters.subtitle: The bird’s reference to its getting trapped by the hunter’s acts with treachery and cheating by calling as pious and noble; and the hunter’s reply thereat.

sections.heading: The Bird Said: “This Is a Punishment to One Who Falls into the Treacheries of the Pious People”. the Pious Man Said: “This Is the Punishment for That Madness Which Senselessly Eats the Belongings of the Orphans.” After This the Bird Cried and Lamented in Such a Manner, Thinking of the Punishment as Due to Its Own Fault, That the Hearts of Nets as Well as of the Other Hunters Shivered. It Went on Saying: Contradictory Thoughts in My Mind Broke My Back. O My God! Keep Your Hand on My Head. There Is Great Relief for My Head Under Your Hand. Your Hand Is a Proof of the Grant of Sweets. Do Not Take Away Your Shadow from Above My Head. I Am in Great Distress! Yes! I Am in Great Distress! Sleep Has Turned Its Face Away from My Eyes. I Am in Great Sorrow in Your Separation, O You, Provider of All Pleasing Beauty and Fragrance. Though I Am Not Worthy, yet Nothing Will Happen If You Make Enquiries About the Sorrows of an Unworthy Fellow.”
Five External and Five Internal Senses
paras: What capacity did the world of non-physical existence (‘adam) have to bring things into physical existence? It was your benevolence only that opened the door to it to bring out into existence. You made the filthy nasty slush become so graceful as to put pearls of senses in the pockets of man’s body and for this purpose you created the body earlier and gave it the capacity to receive those pearls. Of these ten pearls, five are apparent and the other five are hidden. [the five apparent senses are related to the eyes, (seeing), nose (smelling), tongue (tasting), ears (hearing) and skin (feeling of heat and cold). The five hidden senses are 1) memory, 2) Imagination on keeping on model of things that you read, think and see in your mind, 3) Intelligence (coming of ideas), 4) ratiocination (developing further thoughts on the basis of earlier thoughts for which, there is no end, transcendental, new thoughts coming for no ostensible source.

sections.heading: Strange Feelings in Repentance
paras: All these have come from the lifeless semen (the thick whitish fluid) which got converted into man. “O High light without your act of grant of inclination to repent, a repentance and its results are only matters of laughingstock. One not inclined towards it just makes fun of it. When your graces fall upon us every hair of arrogance and thought of our being all in all, vanish. You are like the moon and repentable is like the shadow and there is no shadow without light. I am compressed between the pressure of free will and predestination. All my affairs, possessions and programmes are in ruin, and I cry in repentance upon this, that too because of Your own making me to incline toward repentance. This inclination toward repentance is also Your blessing without you all my affairs are disorganized; and how can any work reach its end without you? How can I run away from You when none can live without You. There is no existence of a slave without Your Mastership. O the root of the life! You are the garden of my life as without You, my life is full of sorrows. I have so much love for You now that I have become mad of it having completely lost wisdom and capacity to understand, totally without any sense and control upon what I talk. In this situation of madness, I lose all my sense of modesty and good conduct and speak out about the secret of fate which I ought not to do. How long can I have patience, fear and hesitation in this regard. This can be revealed in a state of inebriation only. So, for I was hidden like the inner sheet of the blanket, but now, I shall jump out from underneath it.

sections.heading: Secrets of Fate (Forces of Nature, Dependence upon Food and Means of Food)
paras: O my friends! The secret is that God has kept the door of the way shut. We are like lame deers, and He is like the lion. In such a case there is no alternative than to submit ourselves to the blood spilling ferocious paw of the lion. So also owe have nothing but to surrender to the wish of God. And know that, as against the lion, He is not in need of food just as the sun does not need food and sleep. He makes the souls like Himself which also do not need food and sleep. He tells us: “come over to Me, become like Me and develop qualities like mine, (independent of food, sleep and all worldly needs) so that you may be able to see face in its own light. Why do you consider yourself to be in love with Me when you have not seen my face? You were made of mud; and you feel crazy of love. You are not provided with the food of the non-material world. such being the case, how do you crave for the things of that world. you are entangled into the affairs of this material world only. You are like the cat that sits near that hole from which it got its food once. Another cat moves about on the terrace, as it had caught a bird there. The center of attraction for one is weaving as one earns his bread through it. Another person becomes a watchman at the gate as he gets his salary by doing that job. All engaged in worldly affairs.
Fearless and independent of needs caught by devil’s insinuation

Yet, there is another person who has no profession, and he sits idle in appearance, but he is facing toward the non-material world (of inner senses, wisdom, knowledge) because it is from this place that he gets the food for his soul. It is he who does the really worthy job, as he is interested in the willingness of God. He has ignored all other jobs in order to meet this job. All others are like children who play for the whole day till the night. They do this for a few days of their life. Someone who realizes the futility of all this and then wakes up to realities. But he is taken over by the devil who like a wet nurse puts him back into sleep with the tapping’s of treacherous, confusing insinuations. This wet nurse of insinuations tells him: “Go back to sleep my deer! I shall not allow anyone to disturb your sleep.” But God says: “man should not yield to this trap. He should cut off himself from the root of sleep and hear the sound of flowing water just as a thirsty man does. I put the sound of flowing water into the ears of the thirsty and I continuingly do this like the down-pour from the sky. Therefore, O lover of mine! Get up and hear the sound of water, drink and quench your thirst and get satisfied and go into sleep once again.”

chapters.title: Low and Higher Grades of Love
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the lover who entered into that room in the night, which was pointed out to him, waited there for some time, when he was overtaken by sleep. The beloved came and found him in sleep and filled his pockets with apricots leaving him in sleep and went away. And to explain the reality of this fact.

paras: There was a man in love in the earlier days who was very committed to his promises. For years together he was in the anxiety of meeting with his moon-like beloved. He was the king of lovers and victims of the love of an empress. Al last he was successful in his love and met his object as one attains one’s object after long, patient waiting. One day his beloved told him: “come over tonight to me as I have prepared a dish of haricot beans for you. Wait for me till midnight in the room so that I may come over there without any calling.”

The man was highly pleased, and he sacrificed an animal and distributed the meat dish and bread as he was pleased to see that his moon has come out of a storm of dust. With all enthusiasm and anxiety, he sat over in the appointed room, in the hope of the promise given over by the beloved. While waiting, he was overtaken by sleep, and fell down and lost control fo himself. For quite some time, he had kept himself awake with efforts, but atleast was taken over by sleep. It is very strange and rare that a lover falls in love while waiting for the beloved. His beloved came over after midnight like a truthful keeper of promise. She saw her lover having fallen down in sleep. She tore a little of his sleeve to confirm her visit and kept a few apricots in his pocket thinking within herself that he is like a child who is in love only with apricots. He should eat them and go to play again. When the lover woke up in the morning, he found his sleeve torne and apricots. He said to himself: My kingly moon is personified truthfulness and faithfulness. She has kept her promise. Whatever that fells upon us is due to our own faults.

sections.heading: True Lover Gets No Sleep
paras: The true lover says: O sleepless heart! We are contented with sleeplessness. We remain awake for the whole night and take long sighs of love like the guards who beat the drums for the whole night on the terrace of the palace. Our apricots are pulverized between the grinding stones. How much even I may say about my pains, is very less. O finder of faults, for how long will you talk of headache and the narrate about pains? I am mad, no doubt. But do not advise a madman anymore!

“I shall not hear anymore about the coquettish styles of the beloved which cause more and more anxieties. I have ahead, tested and tasted them. How long more do you want to test and taste? Whatever, apart from burning and madness is there in love, is for away, having no end, having no concern for me whatsoever. However, you may put totally mad required to be chained as done with madmen. Even if you put two hundred chains on my feet, I shall break and shatter them. The only things that can keep me chained and motionless are the curly tufts of the beloved. Know this my brother, love and self-respect do not go together. O the one in love, never think of standing at the door of self-respect and honour. Time has come when I should be dispossessed of everything. I should give up all visible signs and symbols and become bodyless, non-physical soul. Come over to me, enemy of thinking and sense of honour, and learn about love from me as I have given up all sense of self-respect and modesty.

sections.heading: Loves Strange Magic
paras: Love’s strange magic chases the sleep away, but you are so hard-hearted that it has no impact upon you. Catch hold of the throat of patience and squeeze it, so that the heart of love may lose its heat and go cold. But be sure, so long as I do not totally burn out? Heat of love will not become cold. It requires total burning and getting converted into ash, upon which only the heat of love comes to the end. You should know that the residence of love and its entire family of the feelings of love is my heart. If you want to burn you’re your own house of the heart, you may do so. None can tell you that it is impermissible. O lion of my heart, inebriated with love! You may set fire to your house of love. The house of a lover is better in this condition only. Therefore, when it is totally burnt out, I shall make it a center of all my worship, as I am a lamp and upon burning only, I give out light.

sections.heading: Love Causes Madness
paras: If you are devoid of love, you should learn to love from the lovers. Do not get into sleep and move about in the street of lovers for a night. Look at them! Them have lost their sense and gone mad like Majnun. Like the moth, they have burnt and killed themselves in the pleasure of meeting with the beloved. See everywhere, the boats of all the people have sunk in the ocean of love. Love has become a python and swallowed all of them. It is a python which snatches away the heart and drags and smashes the wisdom of a mountain’s size. Wisdom of the perfumer upon becoming aware of love goes mad and he flows all his distilling equipment’s in the stream. He forgets all his talent of extracting essences from various materials. His wisdom, having sunk in water, loses all its capacities and says: “I have sacrificed myself for the one, who is absolutely one and unmatchable.”

sections.heading: O the One Engaged in Calculations of Profits and Losses, Open Your Eyes and See the Truth of the Impacts of Love and Do Not Say Anymore, That You Are Not Aware of This and That. Get Out of the Sickness of Fallacies and Deprivation and Come Toward, This Ever Living and Ever Holding God’s World. You Will Be Estranged by Looking at This Great Magic and Stop Saying: “I Do Not Know” and Start Saying: “I Know Everything Now!” Get Out of the Stage of Intoxication and Become One Who Intoxicants Others. That Is, Get Out of the Intoxication of Wisdom and Become One Intoxicated by Love. Give Up This Habit of Changing of Colours and Conduct and Develop Strength and Firmness of Behavior. How Proud You Feel of Yourself for This Lowly Attitude? You May See That There Are Many Such Lowly Intoxicated Fellows of Self-Pride at the Corner of Every Street, Who Are Different from Each Other and Opposed to Each Other
paras: On the contrary, those intoxicated with the love of God, how many ever they may be in numbers, they are all one and honorable. Because of their large numbers they do not become cheap and less valued. It is only those engaged in the protection, pomp and pageantry of the bodies as their worshippers, who become cheap and low in value like the dwellers of hell. When the entire world becomes bright with the light of moon, no loss is caused to the moon at all. If the entire world gets filled up with the brightness of the sun, its self-burning and illuminating heat does no lose its worth. Lovers of God are not jealous of each other.

sections.heading: Progressive States of God’s Love
paras: Yet with all these qualifications and disqualifications, you may proceed to go upward, as the kingdom of God is very large and expansive and can be obedient to you. Though this intoxication of yours is like an untrained, free falcon, which flies high above in the sky and settles in the eyerie built on a high isolated rock, yet the lowly ground upon the plain land is better than it, because it has in a settlement of purified impacts. Though intoxication and targetfulness of the self are high elevated states in the path of the search of God, yet there are still better states. Noble people with good deeds (abraa) forget themselves and their affairs and think only of the good of others. They are like those in the intoxication of the welfare of others. They are good in every respect and their state is the state of self-forgetfulness (sukr). Yet there are others who come out of this self-forgetfulness (Sahuu), get themselves lose in God in every respect and become closely to Him (muqarrab). They are better than the abrars. This state is better than that of the abrars. [it is said: hasanatul abraars sayyiaatul muqarribiin: the good deeds of the noble (abrars) are considered as the sins of the closeby to God (muqarribiin). That is while doing good acts, the noble people are conscious of their good acts, the noble people are conscious of their good acts. That is, they keep their good acts before them. They are not fully unconscious and intoxicated. But those closely to God (muqarribs) have totally submerged themselves in God. They are in total intoxication. They have lost the sense of the goodness or badness of what they do. Rather, they are absolutely unaware of what they do or do not do. This is a better state of the love of God — Translator]
The lion of the abraar is like a fox before the muqarrib.

sections.heading: Best Is the State of Muqarribs
paras: Therefore, it is better for you to be in the state of the muqarrab with total loss of the self in God. You should ponder well over this subtlety. You should be able to differentiate between isarrfiil the inspirer of the souls into the dead, the one who is under intoxication and the intoxicator get back to life upon his bugle. While the others being dead get back to their own life those coming out of annihilation in God also get back to life, even though they are not dead but still living in or with God. They not only get back to life from their state of annihilation, but also provide blessings to others like those not dead or living do, as they were not actually dead. The impacts of Israafiil are different upon the dead, the intoxicated and the annihilated.

sections.heading: Negation to Stress Truth
paras: Heart of the One in the state of forgetfulness develops funny thoughts by indulging in contradictory talks like: “I do not know this, I do not know that. Why at all should he bother about his not knowing this or that? Because, his not knowing of this or that, is vague and meaningless. He ought to say as to what is it that he knows about. The purpose of negative expression is to give stress to positive expression. (For example: the part of the statement: “No God,” in “No God but Allah” is to stress upon the positivity of Allah—Qazi Sajjad Hussain). One should ignore the negative aspect and come over to positive aspect. Therefore, give up this: there is no this and there is not that, and bring forward only what is actually there. Ignore the negativity, (caused by forgetfulness) and seek only that intoxication to explain which, narrate the incident of the Turk and the singer that they had at night. Give up negativity and go toward that existence and learn this from the intoxicated Turk.

chapters.title: Different Kinds of Wine
chapters.subtitle: Seeking at the morning drinking time of the intoxicated Turk chief from the singer, and the meaning and exegesis of the Hadith(s). there is a wine with God, which is prepared for His friends, upon drinking which they get a forgetfulness, which cleans them. Wine is in connotion in the vessel of mysteries, sot that the one deprived of secret knowledge may drink it. God has said: As to the righteous, they shall drink of the cup of wine. Innal abraara yashribuuna min kaasin (Jahr: 76: 5). The wine you drink is prohibited. We do not drink other than the permissible wine. Try to become an entity from non-entity so that you may get intoxicated with the wine of God.

paras: An uncultured Turk woke up in the morning being still in the state of inebriation of the wine of the night, called for a singer, so that he could again drag him toward full intoxication. In fact, it is well known that the singer, for the pleasure of the soul, is a coordinator of the intoxicated ones, imbued with spiritual tastes, snacks, food, who are in search of greater intoxication. This is what a Shaikh’s company also does for the seeker of truth. However, in this case, the singer for this Turk was expected to take him toward more pleasing physical and mental intoxication. In both the cases, the intoxicated get greater food and strength from the verses and rhymes of the singer and get greater absorption at their mood. In the case of the godly nonphysical wine, the process is different. It drags the singer towards itself. So also, is the case of the shaikh. Both are dragged toward God by the godly wine. The physical wine drags the drinker towards the singer, but godly wine drags the singer and Shaikh towards God. Singer and the hearer are impacted according to their taste.

sections.heading: Misguidance by Common Names
paras: In Common parlance, both have a common name, but both are quite different as we have earlier narrated about two different persons, both with the common name ‘Hasan’. There is verbal commonness and similarity, but one is a rope, and the other is the sky. Commonness of the name is always misguiding, just as the physical contents and bodies of the faithful and the unfaithful are alike, but not their hearts. Bodies are like the pots with their mouths closed. It is not the pots that are required to be seen but the contents in them. The pot (body) of the faithful is full of the like giving water and that of the unfaithful with deadly poison. You will be successful and wise if you look into the contents of the vessel, as otherwise, the vessels alone will put you in misguidance.

sections.heading: Words Are Bodies, Meanings Their Soul
paras: Even the words should be considered as bodies and the meanings in them as the souls. The physical eyes of man see only the bodies of objects, but the eyes of the soul look at the art and attainments of the souls. Therefore, from the words of this Math(s)navi, there is scope for misguidance but there is guidance from their meanings. This is what is also said in the Quran that from the point of view of the heart, there is guidance for some and misguidance for some others. God forbid! When the gnostic speaks of wine, he does not mean this obnoxious, polluted, prohibited thing. As your lowly wisdom sees only the devilish drink, the drink of the behevence of God does not come into your mind. as the singer and wine are friendly and together, each of them takes the other one towards the other very soon. An inebriated singer receives his food and enthusiasm from song and takes his hearers toward the winehouse. His song is at the starting point of the field and wine is at the other end; and a ruined heart is like a ball getting hits from a curved bat (hockey stick). The ears take him towards what is in the mind. if there is impact of yellow bile in the brain it changes into that of a black bile, resulting in change from anger to irritability. Then two impacts make him go unconscious. These causes and results become one in such a situation.

sections.heading: Song of Self-Forgetfulness
paras: When the Turk found pain and pleasure having joined together and become one, he woke up the singers. Then the singers started singing songs in a state of inebriation: “O the one, not seen by me, invisible to me, give me a cup of wine. You are not different and away from me. There is no wonder in being so, because you are none other than my own face. No one can see his own face, even though it is the closest to him. I too cannot see my own face. Extreme closeness becomes a curtain causing suspicions. You are my wisdom, and I cannot see you because wisdom cannot be seen. there is no wonder in it, because it is hidden in large coverings of suspicions. You are close to me than my jugular vein. That is why I do not address you with the interjection ‘O’ because this is used to call one who is far away. Rather, I am confusing them all, as I am telling all this into ruins, so that I may satisfy myself of having called yet keeping my friend in hiding, as I am ashamed of him and do not wish to expose myself before him.”
O dear! There is no end to this discussion. Now you may hear a point from a highly distinguishing and deciphering person.

chapters.title: Prophet’s High Merits
chapters.subtitle: Coming of a blind man in the house of the noble Prophet and the truthful ‘Aaisha’s going inside and the Prophet ‘s asking the reason for going away from him as he could not see you being blind? And H. ‘Aaisha’s reply thereto

paras: A blind man came into the house of the noble Prophet. Saying: “You are an oven in which mast is baked to provide different kinds of food. You are the possessor of water, and I am in search of water to quench my thirst. O my provider of water, I seek your indulgence, “give me water”.

sections.heading: When the Blind Man Entered into the House, H. ‘Aaisha, the Prophet’s Wife, Went Fast Inside to Hide Herself. the Prophet Gestured to Her Not to Hide as He Does Not See You. but She Gestured to Convey: He Does Not See Me, but I See Him. This Was Because, the Noble Lady Knew That the Prophet Was Very Self-Respectful of Himself and Had Great Regard of Himself. Beautiful Persons Have High Esteem of Themselves, as Esteem Is a Result of High Regard and Affection Shown by Others, and in Particular by God. That Is Why, Elderly Women Provide Company of Young Maids to Their Husbands as They Are Aware of Their Old Age, and Unpleasant Appearance of Themselves
paras: How did the beauty and grace of both the worlds come about in the Prophet and since when? This was entirely due to the provision made by God. He was provided with high esteem, self-respect, self-regard and self-realization. That was the right and privilege of the sun that was a hundred times brighter than the sun. From this point of view, the Prophet has a right to say that: “he has thrown away the ball of beauty into the far away planet, Saturn and therefore all other stars should not claim any beauty anymore and hide their faces behind veils. Merge yourself into the unmatchable rays of my light, as otherwise you will get disgraced before it. Every night, I go away and hide myself out of my grace like the sun, so that like the bats, you may move around in the air at night. But actually, I do not go anywhere like the sun. I am always there but I pretend as though I have gone away. This I do so that you may exhibit your beauty as the peacocks do by spreading their feathers, and then get lost within yourself, get pleased and feel proud of yourself. And also to find you the difference between beauty and ugliness, then look like the peacock does, upon its legs.

Now you may look at your old sandals as Ayaz did. These sandals were the guiding light for Ayaz. In order to warn, I again show my face in the morning, so that you may not become one of those on the left side out of your own self pride.”
Anyway, keep this apart. It is a very lengthy discussion, and my commander has instructed me to avoid it.

chapters.title: Conflict Between Wisdom and Soul
chapters.subtitle: Testing by the Prophet of H. ‘Aaisha by asking her as to why she hides? She need not hide as the blind man cannot see her. This, he did to bring forth the fact whether she was aware of the Prophet’s inner feelings or did so only out of blind followership

paras: In order to know her intentions, the Prophet said to H. ‘Aaisha: “why do you hide yourself? He cannot see you.” she replied with the gestures of her hand: He does not see me. But I see him. [She said in gestures so that her voice also should not enter into a stranger’s ears. If being heard by stranger does not suit to the dignity and majesty of prophet]

sections.heading: Soul Invisible Inspite of Brightness
paras: Wisdom inspite of its greatness, takes the greatness and honor of the soul into consideration and does not speak of it excepting by way of examples and illustrations. Inspite of the soul being so hidden, wisdom takes care to keep its prestige and honor by not speaking directly of it. Wisdom asked the soul: “O so self-respecting one, from whom do you want to hide yourself? There is no need for you to hide yourself by other means because, your extra ordinary, brightness itself is a curtain for you. Do you not see that the sun moves about in the open, without any curtain, and the excessiveness of its brightness itself is a curtain for it. O so self-respecting one, from whom do you want to hide yourself when the ever roaming, ever bright sun also cannot see you. The sense of honor and self-respect in me is so much that I hide myself form the beloved and only stealthily looks at with the fire of this sense of honor and self-respect, armies of my eyes and ears are at war with each other.

sections.heading: Say Less to Hide More, Silence Is More Expensive

O My Life and Soul! with so Much of Envy (Self-Respect and Self- Honor) for Yourself, It Is Better That I Keep My Mouth Shut and Stop Talking. yet, There Is a Fear That If I Completely Stop Talking That Sun May Turn Its Face to the Other Side and Tear Off Its Curtain and Expose Everything That I Want to Hide. Silence Makes Our Feelings More Expressive Creating Greater Curiosity in Others to Know More. Therefore, I Feel That I Should Express Myself. and Thus, I Am in Conflict in This Matter Whether to Speak or Not. When There Is Greater Turmoil, Sea Water Expresses Itself in the Form of Froth. I Also Feel That I Should Become Froth to Exhibit Myself. Becoming Froth Is an Expression of the Inner Situation. Therefore, Talking, in Fact, Closes the Hole of Curiosity. This Talking Leads to the Actual Hiding of the Fact. Praising the Beloved, a Little by Word of Mouth in Fact Leads to No Praise, as Otherwise the Entire Engagement of the Lover Would Be Only to Look at with Craze. This Is What the Bulbul Does by Crying upon the Flower, so That Your Attention Is Diverted Towards Its Cries, and You Are Prevented from Looking at the Flower and Feel Only Its Fragrance. so That Your Ears Are Engaged in Hearing and Your Eyes May Not Turn Towards Its Face. in Front of the Sun, Which Is Very Bright, All Arguments and Evidence About Its Brightness Are of No Use and Effect.”

chapters.title: Ignorance of Hidden Secrets
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the singer who started singing this sonnet before the Turk chief: “I do not know of the beautiful flowers tongue-shaped leaf, cypress or the moon; I do not know my anxious heart as to what it wants me to talk about.” Upon this, Turk chief cried out loudly: “speak of what you know.” And the singers answer thereon

paras: The singer started singing before the intoxicated Turk chief about the curtains behind which lie the secrets of Alast — (of life, God’s connections with man’s life, existences and annihilations etc. its full meaning is clearly explained in previous pages). He said: “I do not know whether you are moon or an idol and I do not know as to what you want from me. I do not know as to what I should do for you: whether I should remain silent or talk about you. It is strange that I am not different and separate from you; and I do not know as to where I am and where you are. I do not know as to why you drag me toward yourself within your arms at one time you give fresh life; and at another, your finish me off as dead and push me away.”

sections.heading: Deny Falsity to Emphasize Truth
paras: In this manner, the singer was speaking out “I do not know”, “I do not know” repeatedly in his song. And he was very much sunk in his accent and melody of “I do not know” and corresponding lack of knowledge about all these things. And this went on beyond the patience, out Turk who felt much grieved, got wild and jumped from his seat with a mace in his hand to hit upon the singer’s head and ran toward him, when his bodyguard held his hand and said that the singer should not be hit at this moment of his sinking in the meanings and melodies of the song. The Turk chief said: this repetition of this unlimited “I do not know” caused great annoyance to my mind and I shall smash his head. O shameless fellow! If you do not know, stop this nonsense and go after filth. Sing of what you know and meet your object, O fool! Do not go on dragging and bragging of this tune of “I do not know”. I ask you a simple question as to from where you are! You go on saying, I am not from Balkh or Herat. Neither from Rome, nor from India nor from China. Neither from Syria, Iraq or Azerbaijan. Neither from Baghdad or Mosil or Taraz. You go on blabbering of this — neither nor and or and go on a long journey of negatives! Give a simple answer as to from where you are and get rid of all nonsense. The right answer is in giving a clear-cut answer about the place to which you belong. Or if I ask you as to what you ate at breakfast, instead of giving a straight answer, you start saying: it is neither wine nor roasted meat, nor vegetables, butter, onion, milk, sugar, honey; nor meat-chops, gravy, lintel soup! Tell me what exactly you have eaten. What is the reason for this lengthy blabbering?”

The singer said: “there is a hidden object behind this without making denials first, acceptances cannot be perfect and final. When acceptance and positivity are very much above the level of presentation, denials have to be done first to emphasize acceptance. This has to be done for acceptance in entirety. I play this instrument to cause negation and rejection so that it may speak of the secret of death to me, after death.

chapters.title: Die Before Death
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the Prophets statement: “Die before death” and the verse of Hakim Sanaa’ii, may his secrets remain clean. Die before death my friend if you desire to live. As H. Idriis went to paradise well before death, before us

sections.heading: All Steps Must to Reach the Goal
paras: You have struggled very much, but you are ignorant, and still behind the curtains, because dying is the basic requirement to get (lasting life), which you have not attained. Without dying all your efforts are not complete. Without climbing upon all the rungs of ladder, you cannot reach the terrace. One who leaves two rungs unclimbed out of a hundred cannot succeed in reaching the terrace. A rope less by one yard out of hundred yards to reach water cannot dip the bucket into water to draw water. O chief! You may know that your boat will not sink into the water of life unless the last maund of weight to sink is not put into it. Consider this last mound of weight as a guiding star, which sinks the boat of insinuations and misguidance. When existence gets lost in annihilation, it becomes the bright sun in the blue dome of the sky. This happens when the boat of all senses sinks into the water of non-existence. If you do not sink into the world of realities and try to ascertain them merely by thinking and meditation, you will take a very long time to know. Therefore, o beautiful lamp from Firaz the city of beautiful maidens, blow off yourself in the morning and give up your life. Your burning for the whole night does not take you to the goal. So long as we do not discard to look at the petty stars in the night, we remain deprived of the bright sun of the day. Hit your mace upon and smash yourself, destroy yourself, stop looking at yourself, as your physical eye is a cotton swab for your ears. That is to say, your physical connections will keep you away from going deep into your inside and see from there through the spiritual insight.

sections.heading: Negativity Leads to Affirmation
paras: Do not be foolish to hit me with your mace. By hitting upon me you are hitting upon yourself. You are the reflection of what all I say and do. You are in fact, seeing your own reflection in me and you are trying to fight against yourself only, like that lion which jumped into the well to finish the lion in it, which was his own reflection in well water. Negativity is the opposite of positiveness. That is why I resorted to it so that you may understand properly. This is so not in this matter alone. Even in respect of the understanding of God, negativity of the others than Him has to be resorted to because, man is entangled in the worldly affairs so much that he has to be taken out of them to other things including false Gods. If you want to see things without the curtains of the world, you have to disconnect yourself from the world, which can be done only by annihilation in God.

sections.heading: Annihilation Means Transference, Not Death
paras: “But this annihilation is not like the death that takes you to the grave, but the death that results in your transfer from the dark material world to the world of spiritual brightness. This transfer is like the one from childhood to youthfulness, when childhood dies. One became fair like a Roman after losing ones darkness of the negro. Gold ore got cleansed of mud and became pure gold, or sorrowfulness created scope of happiness. This is what the noble Prophet said to the seekers of secret knowledge: “Do you want to see a dead man, who is alive and walking on the earth? He is dead with his life having gone up in the sky? “ Now the destination of his life is high above in the sky: and in fact, when he really physically dies, there is no transfer of his soul as it is already transferred there well before physical death. You cannot see this transfer without your wisdom. This transfer of the soul is not like that of the common people, moving from one place to another. He is dead even though he sees every thing upon the earth. But he is dead though apparently moving upon earth. Such a dead man can be seen in the pious Abu Bakr, who will become the truthful leader of all the truthful on the doomsday. You may look at Abu Bakr in this life so that your certainty of truth may increase. Doomsday is the occasion when the dead regain life after death; and Abu Bakr has already died but continuing to live after death.

Similarly, if you get annihilated in the court of H. Muhammad, which is equal to a hundred doomsdays, all problems of life and death get solved in his court. He also gets annihilated a hundred times and got back into life a hundred times. His birth in this world is a second birth. People used to enquire with him about the doomsday saying: “O doomsday, how far away is the doomsday? “ He used to answer in the language of gestures: “ Has anybody asked the doomsday about the doomsday? That is why the well-informed Prophet has said in gestures the secret of “Die before death”, O honorable people. (Mutuii qabla an famutuu). [This Hadith(s) is not found in the books of a hadith(s). Mulla Ali Qadri has said that this is a statement of sufis, to mean to get into the state of annihilation well before actual death. Therefore, the Prophet said that he died well before actual physical death and so I bring this information from the other world for you — Qazi Sajjad Husain]. That is: because of my having already died, I have brought information and sounds from there.

sections.heading: Therefore, You May Also Become a Doomsday to See the Doomsday. but There Is a Precondition to See Anything and Everything. so Long as You Do Not Fulfil This, You Cannot Understand It in Full Whether It Relates to Darkness or Light. You Should Become a Part of the Thing to Be Understood. You Cannot Understand Slavery Unless You Become One Like a Slave. so Also, Freedom, Unless You Are Born Free. Become Wisdom to Understand Wisdom. Become Love in Full, to Know the Beauty of Love. These Arguments May Mislead One to Conclude That One Should Become God to Understand God. but This Is Impossible. the Only Thing That Can Be Done Here Is to Acquire and Adopt the Attributes and Actions of God, Because It Is Only Through Them That We Can Become a Part of Him. but This Is Not Possible by Everyone. Only Those of Higher Level Can Do so. for Example: Figs Are Very Favorite Fruit in This Region. but Every Bird Cannot Eat It. Only If a Bird of That Ability Comes to This Region as a Guest It Can Eat It
Results of Whole Life Appear at Death
paras: The whole world is full of males and females who are after each other every time. They are so much devoted to each other as to die for each other. They only can appreciate each other’s worth that too, only when they belong to the same species. [a male donkey has love for a female donkey and not for a cow or goat. And so on, in respect of all animals — Translator]. [this devotion to each other to the extent of living and dying for each other becomes so sincere and affectionate at the time of one’s death, that it is considered as a state of melancholia or stupor of death by the sufis, when a situation of total disinterestedness in life and excessive feelings of concern for others comes about with total riddance of jealousy and hate for others — Qazi Sajjad Husain]. Consider this devotion to each other as an advice that the father gives to his son at the time of death to inculcate in him the sense of self-respect and generosity which may cut off the roots of jealousy and ill will from his heart. This is because, the ultimate and final result of the actions and experiences of one’s entire life appear before one at the time of death.

All the feelings and concerns of one go toward the son. With these feelings and concerns, you should look at your relatives and friends so that your heart may also get the same satisfaction which a dying father gets while advising his son at the time of death. Consider that what all has to come in future has already come before you. Consider that your friend has lost himself in every manner first as at the time of his death and as acquired all knowledge. That will eliminate your sense of superiority and arrogance from your heart and cleanse of all illness. With all these development in you, you will see some godly attributes and actions in you which will help you in understanding God. These are from the positive angle.

sections.heading: Seek God’s Pardon, If Good Results Do Not Appear
paras: However, it happens that your selfishness and self-importance come in the way of your attaining all this like curtains which will block your way. These have to be removed. Positively as stated above has to be coupled with negativity of vicious feelings. If you cannot do this, do not consider yourself helpless and stick on to it, because with every person there is another to eliminate helplessness. Helplessness is a chain which is put around you by the chain maker. Therefore, look at this chainer, that is, God, in all humility saying: “O guide of life! I was a falcon. Why have I become a mosquito now? I have made my steps firm in mischief as I have put myself in continuing loss, because of your wrath! I have turned my ears away from your advice. I make a claim that I break the idols of others as against you, but actually I have become an idol maker creating newer and newer idols.”

sections.heading: Death Warns Repeatedly
paras: Which is more essential to think of? Your craftsmanship of more and more things or death? Death is like the autumn season, and you are like the root and leaf. For years together, death has been beating the tambourine, but your ears have been deaf. Your ears will respond at an inappropriate time. They will say: “Ah death!” at the time of departure of life. It is at this time only that death ignores you about itself. Death has called upon you so many times its throat has choked, and its drum burst due to constant beating. You kept yourself engaged in intricate matters, all through and found out the truth of death now. But that is of no use.

chapters.title: Mourning at Later Time
chapters.subtitle: Example of the careless fellow who wastes his life and resorts to repentance and seeking of mercy at the time of death as the mourning of the shi ‘its of Hallab who during ten days of every year mourn at the gate of Antioch. Arrival there of a poor poet after a journey and making enquiries about the crying and loud noise as to in whose grief it was so that he could recite a suitable elegy

paras: On the tenth day of Muharram, the people of Hallab, (Aleppo) both men and women, gather in large numbers at the Antioch gate of the city for the whole night and mourn upon the family of H. Husain. They cry, lament and mourn as his obedient supporters (Shii‘a) for their sufferings at Karbala on the tenth day of Muharram. They count the tortures and trials the family suffered at the hands of Yazid and Shimar. This was with loud sounds upon events that happened long back, with which the deserts and forests get filled up.

A poor poet came over there after a long journey on that tenth day and heard this loud noise of cries and wailings. He left the city and went towards the gate to enquire about this noise and wailings. He went on asking as to why this mourning’s and upon whose death. He thought that it must be some rich man who died, as such a large gathering could be a simple matter. He asked the people to give him the name and other honorable particulars of that dead man as he was a stranger, and they belong to this place as to what was his name. profession and other character so that he might right an elegy upon his name as he was a poet, so that as a reward for it, he might get some materials and provisions from this place. One person told him: “Oh you are a mad fellow! You are not a shi‘a and an enemy of the family of the Prophet. You do not know that today is the tenth of Muharram and a day of mourning. This is the mourning day for the death of that great man and is better than a century. How can not this event be of worth before a faithful. The love of the earring is equal to the love of the ear. For the faithful people mourning for that clean soul is more well known than the events of hundreds of deluges of Prophet Noah.”

chapters.title: Death: Only a Transference
chapters.subtitle: A word of scorn by the poet to the people of Hallab

sections.heading: Death: No Occasion to Mourn
paras: The poet said: “All this is alright! Where are the days of Yazid now? When had that pain occurred and why is reached this place so late? Even the eyes of the blind have seen those events and the ears of the deaf have heard. Were you in sleep all these days that you tear your clothes now in grief? O careless fellows! Mourn upon yourselves, as the deep sleep of yours is worse than death. H. Husain was a king and his soul god rid of the prison of the body. Where is the reason for our sorrow and biting of our fingers? As he was the king of religion, the occasion of the breaking of the chains of the world is an occasion of joy. He ran toward the tent of his kingdom and shattered and threw away the chains and yokes of life. Every day is a day of kingdom, and every moment is a time of imperial grandeur for him. This will be clear to you, even if you have a particle worth of understanding. And if you are not aware of it, better go away and cry upon yourself, as you are not a believer of the transfer of soul from here to there and of the day of resurrection. You may mourn upon your heart and faith that have gone wrong, as it is not capable of seeing other than ruined mud. Had you seen this, you would have been bold, reliable, contented and sacrifice. Where is the glamour of the wine of faith on your face? You may have seen an ocean, but where do you have the hand of generosity to give to others. One who has seen a flowing stream cannot come in the way of others taking water from it and one who has seen that ocean and clouds will never be miserly.”

chapters.title: Search for a Grain from Heap
chapters.subtitle: Similarity of a greedy man who has not seen the sustenance provided by the Provider and the treasures of God’s generosity to an ant which struggles to drag fast a grain of wheat from a heap with pain and efforts, without looking at the large heap

paras: An ant is anxious and worried about a grain as it is blind to the large heap. It drags that grain with all greed and fear as it does not see the large heap. The owner of the heap says: “How regretful! Your blindness has made a large heap non-existent for you! You see only that from out of our heap as your heart is attached to that single grain.”

sections.heading: Greatness of Man’s Sight
paras: O the one, considering yourself only as a particle, look at Saturn. You are like a lame ant, but be dare enough to look at H. Sulaiman, the king. You are not this petty physical body but that eye which can see large and distant objects much greater than you. If you look at the greatness of your eyesight and soul, you will not care for your body anymore. Man does not mean this flesh and fat, but it is his seeing capacity. Only that is real and worthy which his eye sees. It belongs to him. His eye is an instrument to see God. A pot of water if its eyes are open toward the ocean of God can sink a mountain within itself. When the pot’s soul finds its path toward the ocean, it can enter into conflict with the river Jaihun.

sections.heading: Prophet, Spokesman of God
paras: As the Prophet’s qualities were annihilated in the qualities of God, what all he said were the sayings of God. That is why in many places in the Quran, there is an address to the Prophet: ‘say’ (Qul) to explain that what is said is by God only but that is through the mouth of the prophet as he was annihilated in God. His words and God’s words were the same. What all he said were the pearls from the ocean of Truth, of God, as his heart had penetrated into God’s Ocean.

sections.heading: Greatness of Perfect Man
paras: With all his obediences, when a man’s actions get connected with God, there is no wonder that his potful of water is a river of God. There is no wonder that gnostic, as a fish swimming in the ocean of Gods’ gnosis, becomes a river of water. Your physical sensory eyes are fixed on the markings of the pot and therefore, you see it only flowing in the river. This is a quality of the squint eye which sees two things out of one; as otherwise, it is the beginning and also the end. Therefore, go away from the apparent shape of the pot and look into it. You will see an ocean in it, which has no beginning and end. It is flowing sweet water, which ahs no beginning and end. That is to say: a perfect man has within him countless grants and graces of God. One who is deprived of these is actually in a state of torture of God’s wrath. These grants and graces are upon the perfect man for the reason that this secret of unity of God may be revealed to the world and that the perfect man may become an expert and devotee of God. Also that, he may struggle more and attain further prosperity so as to be able to look at God.

sections.heading: Perfect Man: One with God
paras: In this manner, men of heart are such that streams of graces spring from them and with the ocean of life they have become one with God. That is: there are not separate from God. They are just like a small pot but containing within it a large ocean. Such persons become a cause of the life of the earth and heavens. That is: everything within the earth and heavens is before their sight. With their merger with God, they attain unity with Him, resulting in their words as the words of the Lord of Majesty and Grandeur. Therefore, they say: ‘I am the truth’ as Mansur Hallaj had said, so that they may be disgraced with their love for Him and handed on the scaffold. This can become known upon getting into the other life. And how is this further Life? Do not engage yourself in arguments about it, but rather, go is search of it. Dying first is the pre-conditions to get the other life, because getting another life means the regaining of life by the dead. The entire world is away from this knowledge and track and thinks of death as the end and is therefore fears nonexistence, even though that itself is real life.

sections.heading: Pre-Conditions for Attainments
paras: We cannot know of anything by blocking the way of learning. So also, we cannot seek peace by discarding peace. We cannot get a state of mind by giving it up. We cannot talk by giving up speech. We cannot search for existence by ignoring existence. We cannot get authority and power by ignoring them. Thus, there are many pre-conditions of desires, efforts, knowing etc., to attain particular states. So also, we can know of the next life by giving up this life. God is the best supporter in getting these rewards. Pray to Him to provide you good states and also to provide the eyes that can make you see the non-existents as existing. Pray to Him to grant you the eyes that have come from the non-existent, non-physical, spiritual world. if both of your eyes become bright and changed, this well-organized world will appear to you to be dis organized as on the doomsday. Realities appear to be incomplete to those who are incomplete in wisdom as realities are prohibited for them. Grants of paradise are prohibited for the dwellers of hell, inspite of the God’s being so generous. Honey of paradise appears bitter to them as they are the people who are not honest and sincere to the promise, they gave to God o the day of Alast, the day of their coming into being.

sections.heading: Difference Between Genuine and Non-Genuine Seekers
paras: You cannot carry on a trade when there are no customers. It is the customers who give beauty and grace to the bazars and not those loafing about, who go on making enquiries of the price of this and that material into order to pass time and for entertainment. They simply make enquiries to take rest in your shop as they are not in real need of materials. They look at the materials for a hundred times and return to you. They do not see the measurement of the cloth but only measure the air. There is a grandeur, seriousness commitment on the part of the real purchasers; For the other fellows, visiting the bazar is a matter of fun, entertainment and foolishness, because they do not have any money in their pockets to buy and go on looking into the packets of their garments only for show. They do not have any money to buy goods. What si their worth and of their senseless existence as they are only shadows. Gold is the capital in the bazars of this world; and what is required in that world is the capital of love, and two wet eyes. One who goes to the bazar without capital loses his time and returns empty handed.

sections.heading: No Need to Be Desperate
paras: When such a fellow is asked as to where he had been, he says: “nowhere”. When he is asked as to what gravy he has prepared for his dinner, he says: “none”. The first thing he should do is to become a buyer so that my hands may move to serve him, so that his pregnant mine may deliver the rubies as its babies. However, even if the buyer of faith is slow, lazy and disinterested, you may go on inviting him towards the faith as you have been commanded to do so. You may fly off your falcon like greatness of faith to catch a lowly pigeon. Resort to the conduct of H. Noah in the matter of invitation towards faith. Keep yourself engaged in the work of God and do not concern yourself with acceptance and rejection by the people.

chapters.title: Not for Immediate Result
chapters.subtitle: Story of a person who was beating drum before a house at midnight to wake up the dwellers to eat the pre-dawn meal of Ramadhan. A neighbor told him: “it is only midnight now and not the pre-dawn-mealtime; and also that there is nobody in this house. Why do you beat your drum?” And the answer of the drumbeater Narrative of H. Bilal’s saying ‘the one and only’ repeatedly (Ahad) with the love the noble Prophet at midday, whose master, with the fanaticism of rejection was beating him with thorny wooden stick under the hot summer of Hijaz, resulting in the oozing of blood out from his body. Without any willingness the words: ‘Ahad, Ahad’ were coming out from his mouth just as those in troubles. Cry out spontaneously unwillingly. This was because, H. Bilal was full of the pain of love and there was no thinking in him to get rid of the pain of thorny stick just as the magicians of the days of Pharoah and H. Jarjis, and others who cannot be counted and numbered. H Abu Bakr’s passing that way and seeing that affairs and advising H. Bilal

paras: A person was beating his drum at a door to wake up the inmates for pre-dawn meals. It was the mansion of a chief of the king’s court. It was just midnight not a suitable time for beating the drum. A passerby said to him: “O beggar! First, you should beat the drum at the time of pre-sawn meal. You should not create this noise at midnight out of your impatience for alms. Secondly, you greedy fellow, you should know whether here are any residents in this house or not. None other than devils and fairies live in this mansion. Why do you waste your time? You are beating the drum for the purpose of the ears! But where are the ears here? Sensible ears are required to here you. But where is the sense here?”

sections.heading: Things Differently Seen by Different Persons
paras: The drumbeater said: “you have said what all you wanted to say. Now you may hear from this poor servant, so that your anxiety and worry may go. Though it is midnight for you, but before me it is a pleasurable morning time. Every defeat is a victory before me, and all dark nights are bright days. The water of river Nile is blood for you, but O noble man! It is water for me and not blood. What is a hard iron ore in your hand is pliable wax in H. Dawood’s hands. In your view the hills are hard rocks, but before the melodious H. Dawood they are singers. For you, tiny stones are dumb and silent, but before Prophet Muhammad they are talkative and supplicators. Before you, the pillar of the mosques is just a dead wood but before H. Muhammad it is heart full of love. All things of the world for the common people are dead, but they are all wise and obedient before God.

sections.heading: Good Acts: for Their Own Sake
paras: “And for what you said that there is nobody in this mansion and why you beat the drum, I would say that those who work and give charity in the name of God, do so to lay the foundations of masjids and hundred of charitable acts. During the haj season they spend money and physical energy to go on long distances like lovers having lost their senses. They go to the God’s house, pray and supplicate there. They never ask whether the house is occupied or not. It is only uninformed persons who make this remark. The one who has received the light from the light of God always sees the house of God always occupied. There are many houses full of many persons, but they are empty of the eyes that see far away things and ultimate results. You may search for those you want to see in the ka’aba of your heart who will instantly be visible to you there. A face that is worthy of pride and high state, can never be devoid of the house of God. These are of the gnostics, who do not have a door to be shut while others are always in the need of their presence.

sections.heading: Physical Attendance Is Also Needed
paras: “Haji’s say: I am present, I am present (Labbaika) without anybody’s asking whether they have come. It is not their say tat they are present. In fact, they are actually and physically very well in attendance. Yet they say so. As against this you are questioning as to why this announcement of: ‘I attend’. Everyone knows that it is God’s own co-ordination upon their hearts that is bringing out tis response; and also, that there is always such a co-ordination from God at every moment. I can smell from this mansion that it is a place of soul’s occupation, and its dust is like alchemy. I am allowing myself to touch this alchemy with the high pitch and low pitch of my drums, so that with the beatings of drum they may get enthused and spill over pearls from their graceful ocean. You should know that many people play with their lives in the ranks of the battlefield and sacrifice themselves.

sections.heading: Facing Troubles for God’s Sake
paras: “One misery was like that of H. Ayub and another was like that of H. Yaqub to show patience upon troubles. Another underwent great troubles like H. Noah and another was in the battle field like H. Muhammad. It was for the sake of God that H. Abuzar Ghaffari was so cautious to refuse worldly possessions and there was H. Umar so firm and hard in his commitments (that he inled over large territories).
Lakhs of people in thirst and poverty go in search of God with great greed. I am also beating my drum in the hope of faineance of my wrongs and also of grants along with faineance.

sections.heading: God Is the Best Buyer
paras: “You search for a purchaser through whom to seek wealth. But you should know that there is no better purchaser than God. God purchases defective materials from your shop and in return gives a light that brightens your heart. He takes this mortal decomposable body and grants a kingdom for greater and larger than what we can hope for. He takes a few tears from our eyes and grants the water of kauth(s)ar which is sweeter than honey. He takes the sighs full of smoke emanating from the fire of our love and against each sigh he gives us great states and profits. For the air blown from his sighs and the clouds of tears that flowed from the heart of H. Ibrahim, He has called him “great sigher” (Awwahun).

Therefore, sell all your old, out-dated materials in this incomparable-large-market and take in return, new kingdoms. If doubts and suspicions prevent you from this, learn the lessons from the salesmanship of the prophets. That Great Emperor elevated their state to such high levels that even lofty mountains cannot bear their weight.”

H. Bilal was sacrificed his body for the thorns, with which his master was beating him as a punishment saying: “why do you take the name of Muhammad? You are a vicious slave and rejector of my faith.” This beating was under the hot sun. but H. Bilal was taking the name of God, saying: ‘Ahad, Ahad’ ‘the one and only’, repeatedly taking it as a sign of victory.

H. Abu Bakr passed that way and the sound of ‘Ahad’ fell into his ears. His eyes filled with tears and heart with mercy. He felt the fragrance of his own love in the sound of ‘Ahad’. Then he met H. Bilal in loneliness and advised him to hide his faith from the infidels as God is fully aware of all secrets and He knows about your faith very well even without announcing. H. Bilal said: “O great one! I take your advice and I repent for the open announcement before you.’

sections.heading: Repentance upon Earlier Repentance
paras: On the next day, H. Abu Bakr passed on that way on some other job, and again heard the sound of ‘Ahad’, ‘Ahad’, and of the beatings with thorny stick. There arose a great turmoil and fire in his heart. He again advised H. Bilal, and he one again repented. The love of faith took him over and swallowed his repentance. In this manner the state of repentance and its violation; occurred many times, and finally H. Bilal got disgusted of repentance and gave it up for all time. He openly submitted his body to troubles saying within himself: “I repented from saying ‘Ahad’ to avoid pains upon my body because Mohammad has occupied all my muscles and veins and I felt that any pain to my body is pain to him. Where is the scope to avoid pains to myself, when body is not mine? It is Muhammad’s body, who am I to repent for his pains? I repent to avoid pains and then I repent from that repentance. Now onwards, I shall totally eliminate the feelings of repentance from my heart. The life I now have with Muhammed’s love in me is as pleasing as paradise. How can I think of getting rid of it?

sections.heading: Victim of Love
paras: “Love has dominated over me, and I am a slave of love now. Love is saltish, pungent and piercing but because of its excessiveness, I have become soft and sweet. I am like a scrap before fierce wind. I do not know where it will carry and drop me. Whether I am Bilal the dark Abyssinian or a crescent moon, I am on the run following the path shown by your sun. what concern has a new narrow crescent or a full-grown moon, for itself. It simply runs behind the sun (of Muhammad) like the shadow. This is what has been decided by fate. There is no escape from fate. Anyone trying to go against fate gets defeated and becomes a laughingstock. This is as destructive as the doomsday. Due to the impacts of love, I am as uncomfortable and disturbed as a cat in a bag, which jumps within it sometimes high above and falls down below.

sections.heading: Love in Motion Everywhere
paras: Love makes me turn around my own head. I do not have any rest under me or above me. Lovers are always caught in a fast-flowing river surrendering themselves in full to the decision of love. Like the grinding stone turning around the pivot, they are in continuing motion around it with crying sounds day and night. The motion of the scraps on the river is an evidence of the river’s motion. So also, the disturbed condition of the lovers evidences the authority of God. But you can see the motion of the flowing river on the land, but you cannot see the up and down motions that are hidden inside a man. You may look at the motions of the watermill of the heavens. Heavens have no rest as per the decision of God. They have always to be in motion. Do not expect the stars also to be at rest anytime. So also, the man’s heart as tiny as a star to be at rest inside him.

sections.heading: Fate: as Natural Law
paras: Anything that you catch hold of against fate is weak like a tiny twig. Fate will break it off. Ruin if you bring together many twigs, all of them will be shattered from each other by fate. If you cannot directly see the actions of fate. You may look at the results, products and turmoil’s of God’s actions. It is very easy then to assess about God’s actions, as easy as to assess that the scraps are flowing on water. And from the froth that you see, as it is a product of the ocean’s actions. They are all in action as though under the whips of a whipmaster. Look at the might and violence of the stormy whirlwinds, before which the high tides of the oceans go into turmoil. Both sun and moon are like the oxen tied to the yoke moving around the oil crusher, unthinkingly with full obedience. Planets also run from constellation to constellation and become the causes of prosperity or adversity. If you cannot observe and study the stars that are far away from you, you may look at your own slow and fast moving senses and consequent steps.

sections.heading: Stars of Heavens and Human Senses
paras: Look at the stars of your eyes, ears and senses and see that they are different in your waking state and in sleep. Sometimes they co-ordinate with each other, happy and joyous and sometimes go unconscious because of adversity and separation from each other. The moon also is moving on its orbit and therefore at times it is bright, brighter and dark. Sometimes the season is spring, hot, and pleasing like honey and milk and at times it is icy and chilly as though inflicting punishment. All things are like balls before Him, receiving the hitting’s of His bat in total obedience to his design.

O my heart, you are so tiny and just a small bit among the hundreds of thousands of other things and therefore you cannot remain undisturbed and undistressed under His command. Be like a horse under the control of your rider, sometimes kept idle in the stable and sometimes on walk in the fields. When He ties you up to the peg, you should remain tied up and when He frees you, start walking and be smart. You may see that when the sun takes a little deviation from its path in the space, its face become black behind the eclipse. Therefore, be careful to avoid being eclipsed like the sun, which becomes black like a cauldron [ so also to avoid sins to avoid black face.] Even the clouds are whipped by angels (natural forces) with fiery whips directing them to move in different directions and fall in one valley and avoid the other. Thus, clouds are also under compulsions. You may note that your wisdom is not greater than the sun, which is also under control; and therefore, do not hold on to something you are prevented from.

sections.heading: Sins Eclipse Wisdom
paras: O wisdom! Do not put your steps on the wrong path so that you may also not get eclipsed. When sins committed are few, there will be a partial solar eclipse on your face. When you will be half bright and half dark. Because I catch you for your sins proportionately. This is the rule of law of grants and punishments. [This is what is stated in the Quran: Judgement between them will be with justice, and no wrong will be done unto them: Wa qudhiya bainahum bil qisti wa hum laa yazlamuuna: (Yunus: 10: 57)]
God says: “whether the acts are righteous or wrong, open or hidden, we are watchful upon them with full sighting and hearing.”

sections.heading: Love Overtakes Wisdom
